# AGENTS.md – Etsubi front end rules

Read this whole file before you touch `frontend/`. These rules bind every agent (Claude, Codex, Copilot…) and every human working on the Etsubi front end. If a rule here conflicts with a habit, the rule wins. If a rule seems wrong, ask the team; do not silently diverge.

Etsubi (越日) is a Vietnam–Japan student forum, the IE104 (UIT) course project. The back end is a Rust/Actix API in `backend/`. The front end is in `frontend/`.

---

## 1. Tech constraints (hard rules)

- **Plain HTML + CSS + vanilla JavaScript only.**
  - Allowed: ES modules (`<script type="module">`), `fetch`, native `WebSocket`, `URLSearchParams`, `FormData`, `<template>`, CSS custom properties, CSS grid/flex, `@font-face`.
  - Forbidden: React/Vue/Svelte/Lit/Alpine/jQuery or any UI framework, Tailwind/Bootstrap or any CSS framework, TypeScript, Sass/Less, bundlers (Vite/Webpack/esbuild), transpilers, any build step, npm runtime dependencies.
  - `frontend/package.json` only holds the dev server (`live-server`). Do not add packages.
- Every page must work when the `frontend/` folder is served as static files from its root (`/` = `frontend/`). Use **root-absolute paths** (`/styles/…`, `/assets/…`, `/services/…`).
- No inline `style="…"` attributes and no `<style>` blocks in pages. The only exceptions: a CSS custom property set from JS for a dynamic value (e.g. `el.style.setProperty('--progress', '67%')`).
- No inline event handlers (`onclick="…"`). Attach listeners in the page module.
- Do not commit secrets, tokens, `.env` files or real user data.
- **Keep animation to a minimum.** No `@keyframes`, no JS-driven animation, no scroll effects, parallax, animated loaders/skeleton shimmer, or page transitions. Allowed: hover/focus highlight (colour, background, border, underline, shadow change on `:hover` / `:focus-visible`), optionally with one short simple `transition` on those properties. Loading states are static (text "Đang tải…", disabled button, grey placeholder bars). Reason: the team must be able to explain every line to the lecturer; animation code adds complexity for no grade.
- **Comment every code block in Vietnamese.** Every HTML section, every CSS rule group and every JS function/block gets a comment explaining *what it does and why*, in plain language the team can present (e.g. `/* Thẻ đăng nhập: nền kem, viền đỏ 2px, căn giữa màn hình */`). Prefer simple, readable code over clever code.
- **Figma generated code is a starting point only.** You may start from Figma's design-to-code / Figma-to-HTML output (e.g. MCP `get_design_context`), but rewrite it to these rules: plain HTML/CSS/JS, tokens, the shared header/footer, semantic markup, flex/grid layout instead of absolute-positioned soup, no inline styles, no Tailwind/React that the generator emits, no temporary Figma asset URLs.
- **Never use the em dash (Unicode U+2014, the long dash)** anywhere: UI copy, HTML, CSS/JS comments, docs, commit messages. Use the en dash (U+2013, `–`) or a hyphen (`-`) instead. This overrides Figma text that contains an em dash (e.g. footer "IE104 – UIT"). Check before committing: `git grep -nP "\x{2014}" -- frontend AGENTS.md HANDOFF.md` must return nothing (older team files such as README.md and docs/ are out of scope).

## 2. Folder layout and naming

```
frontend/
├── index.html                    # redirects to /pages/index.html
├── pages/                        # one HTML file per screen (+ its page module next to it)
│   ├── index.html                # Home (placeholder, to be built)
│   ├── search.html  search.js    # Search (empty + results states)
│   └── profile/
│       ├── login.html            login.js
│       ├── register.html         register.js
│       └── register-advanced.html register-advanced.js
├── components/                   # reusable UI rendered by JS (one folder per component)
│   ├── header/header.js  header.css
│   ├── footer/footer.js  footer.css
│   ├── tag-chip/tag-chip.js  tag-chip.css
│   └── postcard/PostCard.js  PostCard.css
├── services/api/                 # talking to the back end, nothing else
│   ├── client.js                 # API_BASE, request(), token storage, ApiError, rate limit queue
│   ├── auth.js  users.js  posts.js  tags.js
├── utils/                        # pure helpers + session
│   ├── auth.js                   # session: login/logout/currentUser/requireAuth/safeRedirect
│   ├── dom.js                    # escapeHtml, el(), qs()
│   ├── format.js                 # relative time, initials, highlight
│   └── routes.js                 # every page URL + searchUrl({q, tags})
├── styles/
│   ├── tokens.css                # ALL design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing, radius, shadows)
│   ├── base.css                  # @font-face, reset, body, typography, focus ring, utilities
│   ├── components.css            # buttons, inputs, checkbox, radio card, card, kbd, alerts
│   ├── main.css                  # @imports tokens/base/components (link this on every page)
│   └── pages/<page>.css          # page-only layout (auth.css, register-advanced.css, search.css)
├── assets/
│   ├── fonts/                    # Etsubi Display / Etsubi Logo woff2 (+ OFL.txt)
│   ├── icons/                    # single-colour UI icons exported from Figma (SVG)
│   ├── illustrations/            # sun, clouds, waves, sakura petals (SVG)
│   └── avatars/                  # preset avatars
└── public/                       # favicon etc.
```

- File names: `kebab-case` for pages, CSS, icons and utils. (`components/postcard/PostCard.*` keeps its legacy name.)
- A page's module lives next to the HTML file and has the same base name (`login.html` → `login.js`).
- New page checklist: HTML in `pages/…`, module next to it, page CSS in `styles/pages/`, route in `utils/routes.js`, Figma frame ID noted in `HANDOFF.md`.

### Page skeleton (copy this)

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="vi">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Tên trang · Etsubi</title>
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/assets/icons/etsubi-logo.svg" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Be+Vietnam+Pro:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Noto+Sans+JP:wght@350;400;500;700&display=swap" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/styles/main.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/components/header/header.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/components/footer/footer.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/styles/pages/<page>.css" />
    <script type="module" src="/pages/<area>/<page>.js"></script>
  </head>
  <body class="page page--<page>">
    <a class="skip-link" href="#main">Bỏ qua điều hướng</a>
    <header class="site-header" data-component="header" data-active="home"></header>
    <main id="main" class="…">…</main>
    <footer class="site-footer" data-component="footer" data-variant="full"></footer>
  </body>
</html>
```

The page module calls `mountHeader()` / `mountFooter()` from the components. Never copy header/footer markup into a page.

## 3. CSS conventions

- **Tokens only.** Every colour, font family, radius, shadow and spacing value comes from `styles/tokens.css` (`var(--color-red)` etc.). Hard-coded hex values are allowed only inside `tokens.css` and inside SVG files. One-off illustration colours (the torii on Login/Register) are tokens too (`--torii-*`).
- **BEM-like class names:** `block`, `block__element`, `block--modifier`, state classes `is-active`, `is-open`, `is-invalid`, `is-loading`, `is-disabled`. Prefix utilities with `u-` (`u-visually-hidden`). Never style by ID; IDs are for JS hooks and labels.
- **JS hooks:** select elements with `data-*` attributes or IDs, not with styling classes (`[data-search-input]`).
- **Breakpoints (desktop-first, matching the 1920 design):**
  - `> 1280px` desktop: the Figma layout.
  - `≤ 1280px` laptop: side columns shrink/stack, decorative art scales down.
  - `≤ 960px` tablet: single column, header nav collapses into a menu button.
  - `≤ 600px` mobile: 16px side gutters, full-width cards, no horizontal scroll.
  Write breakpoints as `@media (max-width: 1280px)`, `(max-width: 960px)`, `(max-width: 600px)` – no other values.
- Content width: `--container-width: 1440px` with `--page-gutter` padding (48px desktop → 16px mobile). Search/content pages use the 1096 + 24 + 320 grid inside it.
- Units: `px` for borders/radius/icons, `rem` allowed for type; spacing from the 4px scale.
- No `!important` except in `u-` utilities.

### Fonts

- Body: **Be Vietnam Pro** 400/500/600/700 (Google Fonts) → `--font-body`.
- Japanese: **Noto Sans JP** (Google Fonts). Wrap Japanese runs in `<span lang="ja">`; `:lang(ja)` switches to `--font-jp` automatically.
- Headings (≥ 20px and ≥ SemiBold in Figma): **Etsubi Display** Bold → `--font-display`, class `.t-display`.
- The brand word "Etsubi": **Etsubi Logo** Bold → `--font-logo`, class `.brand-word` (the font turns the exact string `Etsubi` into the leaf-E/flower-i ligature; keep `font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures`).
- Etsubi fonts are self-hosted in `assets/fonts/` (woff2, OFL). They have no Japanese glyphs.

### Spacing, radius, shadows

- Spacing scale `--space-1..10` = 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 72 px.
- Radius: `--radius-sm 4px` (cards with 2px red border), `--radius-md 6px` (inputs, buttons, result cards), `--radius-pill 999px` (chips, search bar, pills).
- Shadows: `--shadow-card` `0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.16)`, `--shadow-card-strong` `0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.2)`, `--shadow-sidebar` `0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.1)`, `--shadow-result` `0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08)`, `--shadow-button` `0 6px 8px rgba(194,69,79,.25)`, `--shadow-navbar` `0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1)`.
- Focus ring (Figma style "Etsubi/Focus Ring"): `box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(220,58,72,.18)` → `--focus-ring`. Every interactive element must show it on `:focus-visible`.

### Shared header (`components/header`)

- Red bar (`--color-red`), height 77px, 48px side padding, shadow `--shadow-navbar`.
- Left: circular Etsubi logo with white ring (`assets/icons/etsubi-logo.svg`) + "Etsubi" in Etsubi Logo, white. Links to Home.
- Tabs, in this order: **Trang chủ · Diễn đàn · Hỗ trợ · Giới thiệu** (17px, Medium, white 85%). Every tab has the same box (label + 3px underline slot), so labels always line up vertically. The active tab gets white text + visible pink underline. On the search page **no tab is active**.
- Right, in Figma order: when signed in **notification bell → language badge (VI/JA/EN) → gradient avatar** with initials (38px, 2px white 70% ring); when signed out on content pages: language badge → "Đăng nhập" link. Login/Register show only the language badge (no search icon). Figma also draws a sun "theme toggle" before the bell; there is no dark theme yet, so it is not built (team to decide).
- Variant `search` puts the search bar (660 × 48) right after the logo. On other pages the search shows as an icon button that opens `/pages/search.html`. Home uses `searchForm: true`: a **translucent** pill 520 × 42 on the red bar (white 12% fill, white 22% border, white 60% placeholder and icon, 15px text); on focus the pill brightens its border, the inner input never shows its own focus box.
- `≤ 960px`: tabs move into a menu button (hamburger) panel; `≤ 600px` matches Figma "Mobile · Header" (logo + search icon + avatar).
- Keyboard: `/` anywhere (outside inputs) focuses the search bar or opens the search page.

### Shared footer (`components/footer`)

- `data-variant="slim"` (auth pages): 57.6px bar `--color-red-dark`, centred line "© 2025 Etsubi · 越日 | IE104 – UIT | Cầu nối văn hoá Việt – Nhật".
- `data-variant="full"` (content pages): 4 columns (brand + social icons, Liên kết, Tài nguyên, Liên hệ), divider, copyright "© 2026 Etsubi · 越日 – All rights reserved.".
- Mobile: single centred line "© 2026 Etsubi".

| Search bar | header variant `search` | empty-focused (placeholder, `Esc` kbd, Tag button neutral, **Submit opacity .4 + disabled**), has-query (clear ×, Tag button pink with count badge, Submit enabled) |
| Result card / PostCard | `components/postcard` | default (cream, 1.2px red border, radius 6, `--shadow-result`), hover (border turns `--color-red-dark` + `--shadow-sidebar`; no movement), query highlight (red, title) / bold (excerpt) |
| Kbd | `.kbd` | static |
| Alert | `.alert` `--error` / `--info` / `--success` | with `role="alert"` or `role="status"` |

### Icons

- UI icons are Lucide-style line icons. Use the SVGs in `assets/icons/` (exported from Figma) through `<img src alt="">` when the colour is fixed, or **inline Lucide SVG** (`stroke="currentColor"`, 24 viewBox, stroke-width 2) when the icon must follow text colour. Never use icon fonts. Decorative icons get `alt=""`/`aria-hidden="true"`.
- **Check every Figma-exported SVG before use.** Figma exports carry `preserveAspectRatio="none"` and sometimes a squashed path (the old `eye.svg` was flattened vertically). If an icon looks thinner or wider than the Lucide original, replace the file with the original Lucide SVG (24 viewBox, stroke-width 2, round caps/joins) in the needed colour, and compare at real size in the browser.
- Native browser controls must not duplicate ours: password inputs hide Edge's own reveal button (`::-ms-reveal`, `::-ms-clear` in `components.css`). Do the same for any input where the browser adds its own control (e.g. `input[type=search]` clear button).

## 5. JavaScript conventions

- ES modules only, `type="module"`, no globals except optional `window.ETSUBI_API_BASE`.
- One module per page. It imports from `services/`, `utils/`, `components/`; it never calls `fetch` directly.
- `services/api/client.js` is the only file that calls `fetch`:
  - `API_BASE` defaults to `http://localhost:11432/api/v1`; override with `window.ETSUBI_API_BASE` or `localStorage['etsubi_api_base']`. (The front-end Dockerfile rewrites this default URL with `sed`, so keep the literal string.)
  - `request(path, { method, body, query, auth })` → parsed JSON or `null`; throws `ApiError { status, message, data }`. `status 0` = network/CORS error.
  - Adds `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when a token exists.
  - The back end rate-limits **4 requests/s per IP (burst 7)**. `client.js` queues requests (max 3 in flight, ~250 ms spacing) and retries `429` up to 2 times with back-off. Do not fire unbounded parallel requests; enrich lists progressively.
- **Token storage:** key `etsubi_token`. "Ghi nhớ đăng nhập" checked → `localStorage`; unchecked → `sessionStorage`. `getToken()` reads both. There is no refresh token: the JWT lives `JWT_EXPIRY_HOURS` (24h). Any `401` from a protected call clears the token and sends the user to Login with `?redirect=`.
- **Error handling:** catch `ApiError` in the page module and show a Vietnamese message in the page's alert/field hint. Map known back-end messages (`Invalid credentials`, `Email already exists`, `Username already taken`, `Username too short`, `Account is banned`…) to Vietnamese in one place (`utils/errors.js`). Never `alert()`.
- Build DOM with `document.createElement` / `<template>` or with template strings **only after** `escapeHtml()` on every dynamic value. Never inject API text with `innerHTML` unescaped.
- Redirects after login use `safeRedirect()` (same-origin paths only).
- Keep state in the URL when it is shareable (search `q`, `tag`).

## 6. Accessibility basics

- Every input has a `<label>`; errors use `aria-invalid="true"` + `aria-describedby` to the hint; form-level errors go in a `role="alert"` region.
- Custom controls wrap real inputs (checkbox, radio, file). Radio cards are a `<fieldset>` with `<legend>`.
- Visible `:focus-visible` ring on everything interactive; tab order follows the visual order.
- Colour contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text (muted `#80736B` on cream is the minimum – do not go lighter).
- `lang="vi"` on `<html>`, `lang="ja"` on Japanese runs.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (no petal animation, no transitions).
- Decorative art (`sun`, `clouds`, `waves`, `sakura`, torii) is `aria-hidden="true"`.
- Images: meaningful `alt`; avatars use the user's name.

### Final review procedure (required before a page batch is called done)

The reviewer (the person or agent who did not write the code) runs every step and fixes or reports each mismatch. Do this for every page touched in the batch.

1. **Get the real numbers from Figma, not from memory.** Use the shared file frame IDs above. `get_metadata` on the frame or instance gives positions and sizes of every child (for example a card's Divider, EngagementRow and DetailButton). `get_design_context` on a small node gives exact colours, padding, gaps and font sizes. `get_screenshot` gives the visual target. Read small nodes, not whole pages, to save the shared file's MCP quota.
2. **Measure the web page the same way.** Serve `frontend/` on `http://localhost:12321` with the back end running. Hard-reload so CSS/JS are not cached: Ctrl+Shift+R, or `fetch(url, {cache:'reload'})` and then reload. Compare with `getBoundingClientRect()` and `getComputedStyle()` in the console: the top, height and padding of the key blocks, and the gap between elements such as a divider and the button below it. Anything more than about 2px off the Figma value is a bug unless it is a documented team decision.
3. **Compare side by side at 1920×1080**, section by section, with the Figma screenshot: header, hero/heading, cards, sidebars, footer. Check alignment, spacing, sizes, colours, font weight and icon proportion.
4. **Check the header everywhere.**
   - Tab labels line up vertically and only the right tab is active (none on Search).
   - Right-side order follows Figma: bell, language badge, avatar.
   - Login/Register show only the language badge.
   - The Home search pill is translucent on the red bar.
   - Clicking any input shows no square browser focus box inside a pill. The whole pill shows the focus state instead.
5. **Check both session states.** Do this signed out and signed in. An info banner or avatar changes the layout, so the signed-out Login/Register card must sit exactly where Figma puts it.
6. **Check the first screen.** At a common laptop browser height (1920×947 viewport), Home's featured cards must be fully visible without scrolling. This is a team requirement that overrides the 480px Figma hero.
7. **Check every state.** Cover hover, focus-visible, disabled, loading text, empty, error and "no results". Placeholders for data the back end lacks must show "–" or grey bars, never invented values (§8).
8. **Check mobile at 375×812.** There must be no horizontal scroll (`document.documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth`), buttons must be full-width where Figma shows it, and text must not be squeezed into narrow columns.
9. **Check icons at real size.** Zoom in on every icon. If one looks squashed, replace it with the Lucide original (§4 Icons). A browser-native control (Edge password eye, search clear ×) must not duplicate ours.
10. **Keep the console clean.** There must be no errors and no failed requests other than the expected 401/409 network lines.
11. **Run the rule checks.** These must all pass:
    - `git grep -nP "\x{2014}" -- frontend AGENTS.md HANDOFF.md` returns nothing (no em dash).
    - No `@keyframes` or JS animation.
    - No inline styles.
    - Every new block has a Vietnamese comment.
12. **Record the result.** In `HANDOFF.md`, list what was fixed, any intentional difference from Figma together with the reason, and any new back-end needs in §5. Then commit.

## 8. Back-end contract (as of `upstream/main`, Nov 2026)

### Front end first: the back end follows the front end

The back-end dev has agreed to **adjust the back end to match the front-end code** (confirmed 2026-11-13). So:

- **Build every screen completely as in Figma.** Do not drop or hide a UI element (counts, featured posts, author name, badges…) just because the current API does not return that data yet.
- **The front end defines the contract.** For each missing piece, write the service function in `services/api/` with the request and response shape the UI needs (endpoint, query params, JSON field names in `snake_case` like the existing API). Add a comment above it starting with `// CẦN BACKEND:` explaining in Vietnamese what is missing.
- **Until the back end has it,** the service returns what it can, and the UI shows a neutral placeholder in that slot ("–" for a number, a grey bar for text). Never show invented numbers or text as if they were real data.
- **Record every request** in the "Yêu cầu cho backend" table in `HANDOFF.md` (endpoint, fields, which page needs it, status). That table is what the team sends to the back-end dev.
- **Do not edit `backend/`** from a front-end branch. Back-end changes are the back-end dev's job.
- Agreed exceptions that stay deferred (do not build UI for them): search over socket (HTTP is used, see Search) and email verification.

Base URL: `http://localhost:11432/api/v1` (local `cargo run`) or `http://localhost:21432/api/v1` (Docker `--profile full`). Swagger UI: `/swagger-ui/`. Errors are JSON `{ "error": "<English message>" }` (some framework errors are plain text).

### Auth (JWT, Bearer header – no cookies, no refresh)

| Call | Body | Success | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /auth/register` | `{ username, email, password, native, language }` | `201 { user_id }` (no token) | `400` username < 3 bytes / password < 8 / bad language; `409` email or username taken |
| `POST /auth/login` | `{ email, password }` (**email only**, no username login) | `200 { user_id, token }` | `401` invalid credentials; `403` banned |
| `POST /auth/logout` 🔒 | – | `204`, bumps `token_version` (all tokens die) | `401` |
| `GET /my` 🔒 | – | user profile | `401`, `403` banned |
| `PATCH /my` 🔒 | any of `{ username, email, institute, address, bio, avatar_url, native, language }` | `200` updated profile | `400`, `409` |

🔒 = `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Write calls from a muted user return `403 "Your account is muted until …"`.

No email verification exists yet (team decision: skipped for now), so registration is active immediately.

Flow used by the front end: Register → (auto) Login with the same email/password → store token → Register Advanced (`PATCH /my`) → Home.

### Users

`users`: `id, username (unique), email (unique), institute?, address?, native ∈ {vi, en, ja} (default vi), language ∈ {vi, en, ja} (UI language, default vi), avatar_url?, bio?, role ∈ {user, moderator, admin}, status ∈ {active, banned}, muted_until?`. `GET /users/{id}` is public. There is **no file upload endpoint**: `avatar_url` is a string (the front end stores a preset path or a small resized data URL).

### Search

- `GET /posts?q=&tags=<uuid,uuid>&limit=&offset=` – published, not deleted posts; `q` matches title or content (ILIKE, max 200 chars); `tags` = **all** listed tags must match; newest first. Returns `PostResponse[]` (`id, author_id, title, content, language, status, comments_locked, created_at, …`) – no author name, tags, counts or total.
- `GET /tags` – fixed set (`general, question, discussion, announcement, showcase`). The UI uses tag **names**; `services/api/tags.js` maps name ↔ UUID.
- `GET /posts/{id}/tags`, `GET /users/{id}`, `GET /posts/{id}/reactions/summary` for enrichment (mind the rate limit).
- **Socket (deferred):** search was planned over a socket, but the back-end dev has not implemented it yet, so the team decided to skip it for now (confirmed 2026-11-12). The back end has **no WebSocket endpoint**. `services/api/posts.js` exposes `searchPosts()` over HTTP behind one function so a socket transport can replace it later without touching pages.
- Search UX rules (agreed): **no live suggestions, no results while typing**. Results load only on Enter or the "Tìm kiếm" button. Submit is `opacity .4` + disabled while there is no query and no tag.
- **Tag → search:** clicking a tag anywhere navigates to `/pages/search.html?tag=<name>` (repeat `tag` for several). The search page treats `q`/`tag` in the URL as a submitted search. There is **no separate tag page**.

### RBAC summary

- Roles: `admin > moderator > user`. Staff = moderator or admin. Nobody can act on an equal or higher role; nobody can assign `admin`.
- Mute: `PATCH /manage/users/{id}/mute { muted_until }` – muted users can read but every write (POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE) returns `403`. Show a banner from `GET /my.muted_until`.
- Ban: `PATCH /manage/users/{id}/status { status: "banned" }` – login returns `403`, existing tokens fail with `403`.
- Posts: `status ∈ {published, hidden}` (staff via `/manage/posts/{id}/status`), soft delete (`deleted_at`, restore via `/manage/posts/{id}/restore`), `comments_locked` (`PATCH /posts/{id}/comments/lock`; authors can lock their own post, staff can lock any).
- Comments: `status ∈ {visible, hidden}` (staff), soft delete + restore.

## 9. Running locally

```bash
# 1) database + API in Docker (first build takes a while)
docker compose --profile full up -d --build postgres backend   # API on http://localhost:21432/api/v1
# 2) static front end
cd frontend && npx live-server --port=12321 --no-browser .      # or: python -m http.server 12321
```

The back end only allows CORS from `http://localhost:12321`, `http://127.0.0.1:12321` (and 22321). With the Docker API on port 21432, open the site once with `?api=http://localhost:21432/api/v1` – `client.js` saves it to `localStorage['etsubi_api_base']` (`?api=reset` clears it).

## 10. Git workflow

- Branch from `main`: `feat/fe-<area>` (e.g. `feat/fe-forum`). One branch per page group.
- Small, logical commits in English, imperative mood: `feat(fe): add search page results state`.
- Never commit `.env`, tokens, `node_modules`, screenshots of real users.
- Before pushing: open every page you touched at desktop + mobile, console clean, links not broken.
- Do not push or open a PR without the user's go-ahead. PRs target the team repo `CNVN2024-2-Boiz/etsubi` from a fork.

===== FILE: backend/docker/entrypoint.sh =====
#!/bin/sh
set -e

if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: DATABASE_URL is not set" >&2
    exit 1
fi

DB_HOST=$(echo "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -E 's|.*@([^:]+):.*|\1|')
DB_PORT=$(echo "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -E 's|.*:([0-9]+)/.*|\1|')
DB_USER=$(echo "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -E 's|.*://([^:]+):.*|\1|')

echo "Waiting for database at $DB_HOST:$DB_PORT (user=$DB_USER)..."
i=0
until pg_isready -h "$DB_HOST" -p "$DB_PORT" -U "$DB_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then
        echo "ERROR: database not ready after 60s" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
done

echo "Running migrations..."
diesel migration run

if [ "$RUN_MODE" = "dev" ]; then
    echo "Starting backend in DEV mode (cargo-watch)..."
    exec cargo watch -x run
else
    echo "Starting backend..."
    exec backend
fi

===== FILE: backend/migrations/00000000000000_diesel_initial_setup/up.sql =====
-- This file was automatically created by Diesel to setup helper functions
-- and other internal bookkeeping. This file is safe to edit, any future
-- changes will be added to existing projects as new migrations.




-- Sets up a trigger for the given table to automatically set a column called
-- `updated_at` whenever the row is modified (unless `updated_at` was included
-- in the modified columns)
--
-- # Example
--
-- ```sql
-- CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW());
--
-- SELECT diesel_manage_updated_at('users');
-- ```
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION diesel_manage_updated_at(_tbl regclass) RETURNS VOID AS $$
BEGIN
    EXECUTE format('CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON %s
                    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE diesel_set_updated_at()', _tbl);
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION diesel_set_updated_at() RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
    IF (
        NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD AND
        NEW.updated_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.updated_at
    ) THEN
        NEW.updated_at := current_timestamp;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

    avatar_url TEXT,
    bio TEXT,
    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user'
        CHECK (role IN ('user', 'moderator', 'admin')),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
        CHECK (status IN ('active', 'banned')),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    muted_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    token_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    author_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    language TEXT NOT NULL,
    latitude DOUBLE PRECISION,
    longitude DOUBLE PRECISION,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published'
        CHECK (status IN ('published', 'hidden')),
    comments_locked BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

ALTER TABLE posts ADD CONSTRAINT posts_location_check CHECK (
    (latitude IS NULL AND longitude IS NULL)
    OR (
        latitude  BETWEEN -90  AND 90
    AND longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180
    )
);

CREATE INDEX idx_posts_status_active
    ON posts (status, created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_posts_author_active
    ON posts (author_id, created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_posts_deleted
    ON posts (deleted_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL;

use std::env;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct TranslationConfig {
    pub provider: String,
    pub model: String,
    pub api_key: String,
    pub base_url: Option<String>,
    pub timeout_secs: u64,
}

impl TranslationConfig {
    pub fn is_configured(&self) -> bool {
        !self.provider.trim().is_empty() && !self.api_key.trim().is_empty()
    }

    fn from_env() -> Self {
        Self {
            provider: env::var("TRANSLATION_PROVIDER").unwrap_or_default(),
            model: env::var("TRANSLATION_MODEL").unwrap_or_default(),
            api_key: env::var("TRANSLATION_API_KEY").unwrap_or_default(),
            base_url: env::var("TRANSLATION_BASE_URL")
                .ok()
                .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()),
            timeout_secs: env::var("TRANSLATION_TIMEOUT_SECS")
                .ok()
                .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
                .unwrap_or(30),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AppConfig {
    pub server_host: String,
    pub server_port: u16,
    pub database_url: String,
    pub jwt_key: String,
    pub jwt_expiry_hours: i64,
    pub cors_allowed_origins: String,
    pub translation: TranslationConfig,
}

impl AppConfig {
    pub fn from_env() -> Self {
        dotenvy::dotenv().ok();

        Self {
            server_host: env::var("SERVER_HOST").unwrap_or_else(|_| "0.0.0.0".into()),
            server_port: env::var("SERVER_PORT")
                .ok()
                .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
                .unwrap_or(8080),
            database_url: env::var("DATABASE_URL").expect("DATABASE_URL must be set"),
            jwt_key: env::var("JWT_KEY").expect("JWT_KEY must be set"),
            jwt_expiry_hours: env::var("JWT_EXPIRY_HOURS")
                .ok()
                .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
                .unwrap_or(24),
            cors_allowed_origins: env::var("CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS").unwrap_or_else(|_| "*".into()),
            translation: TranslationConfig::from_env(),
        }
    }
}

pub mod config;

use actix_web::web;
use std::sync::Arc;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::{config::AppConfig, state::AppState},
    domains::{
        auth::service::AuthService, bookmark::service::BookmarkService,
        comment::service::CommentService, follow::service::FollowService,
        notification::service::NotificationService, post::service::PostService,
        reaction::service::ReactionService, tag::service::TagService,
        translation::service::TranslationService, user::service::UserService,
    },
    infrastructure::{
        database::repositories::{
            auth_repo::PostgresAuthRepo, bookmark_repo::PostgresBookmarkRepo,
            comment_repo::PostgresCommentRepo, follow_repo::PostgresFollowRepo,
            notification_repo::PostgresNotificationRepo, post_repo::PostgresPostRepo,
            reaction_repo::PostgresReactionRepo, tag_repo::PostgresTagRepo,
            translation_repo::PostgresTranslationRepo, user_repo::PostgresUserRepo,
        },
        helper::translation::build_client,
    },
};

pub fn run() -> Result<web::Data<AppState>, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let config = Arc::new(AppConfig::from_env());
    let db_pool = pool::init(&config.database_url);

    let user_repo = Arc::new(PostgresUserRepo::new(db_pool.clone()));
    let auth_repo = Arc::new(PostgresAuthRepo::new(db_pool.clone()));
    let post_repo = Arc::new(PostgresPostRepo::new(db_pool.clone()));
    let tag_repo = Arc::new(PostgresTagRepo::new(db_pool.clone()));
    let comment_repo = Arc::new(PostgresCommentRepo::new(db_pool.clone()));
    let translation_repo = Arc::new(PostgresTranslationRepo::new(db_pool.clone()));
    let bookmark_repo = Arc::new(PostgresBookmarkRepo::new(db_pool.clone()));
    let reaction_repo = Arc::new(PostgresReactionRepo::new(db_pool.clone()));
    let follow_repo = Arc::new(PostgresFollowRepo::new(db_pool.clone()));
    let notification_repo = Arc::new(PostgresNotificationRepo::new(db_pool.clone()));

    let user_service = Arc::new(UserService::new(user_repo.clone()));
    let auth_service = Arc::new(AuthService::new(
        auth_repo,
        user_repo.clone(),
        config.jwt_key.clone(),
        config.jwt_expiry_hours,
    ));
    let post_service = Arc::new(PostService::new(post_repo.clone(), user_repo.clone()));
    let comment_service = Arc::new(CommentService::new(
        comment_repo.clone(),
        post_repo.clone(),
        user_repo.clone(),
    ));
    let translation_client = build_client(&config.translation)?;
    let translation_service = Arc::new(TranslationService::new(
        user_repo.clone(),
        post_repo.clone(),
        comment_repo.clone(),
        translation_repo,
        translation_client,
    ));

    let notification_service = Arc::new(NotificationService::new(
        notification_repo,
        user_repo.clone(),
        post_repo.clone(),
        follow_repo.clone(),
    ));

    let tag_service = Arc::new(TagService::new(tag_repo, post_repo.clone()));
    let bookmark_service = Arc::new(BookmarkService::new(bookmark_repo, post_repo.clone()));
    let reaction_service = Arc::new(ReactionService::new(reaction_repo, post_repo.clone()));
    let follow_service = Arc::new(FollowService::new(follow_repo, user_repo.clone()));

    Ok(web::Data::new(AppState {
        config,
        pool: db_pool,
        auth_service,
        user_service,
        post_service,
        comment_service,
        tag_service,
        bookmark_service,
        follow_service,
        reaction_service,
        notification_service,
        translation_service,
    }))
}


===== FILE: backend/src/bootstrap/pool.rs =====
use diesel::pg::PgConnection;
use diesel::r2d2::{ConnectionManager, Pool, PooledConnection};
use std::time::Duration;

pub type DbPool = Pool<ConnectionManager<PgConnection>>;
pub type DbConn = PooledConnection<ConnectionManager<PgConnection>>;

pub fn init(url: &str) -> DbPool {
    let manager = ConnectionManager::<PgConnection>::new(url);
    Pool::builder()
        .max_size(10)
        .min_idle(Some(2))
        .connection_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
        .build(manager)
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| {
            panic!("Failed to create DB pool (check DATABASE_URL): {e}");
        })
}

===== FILE: backend/src/cors.rs =====
use actix_cors::Cors;
use actix_web::http::header;

pub fn build(origins: &str) -> Cors {
    let trimmed = origins.trim();
    if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed == "*" {
        return Cors::permissive();
    }

    let mut cors = Cors::default()
        .allowed_methods(vec!["GET", "POST", "PATCH", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"])
        .allowed_headers(vec![
            header::AUTHORIZATION,
            header::CONTENT_TYPE,
            header::ACCEPT,
        ])
        .max_age(3600);

    for origin in trimmed.split(',') {
        let origin = origin.trim();
        if !origin.is_empty() {
            cors = cors.allowed_origin(origin);
        }
    }
    cors
}


===== FILE: backend/src/domains/auth/error.rs =====
use actix_web::{HttpResponse, ResponseError, http::StatusCode};
use serde_json::json;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum AuthError {
    #[error("Invalid credentials")]
    InvalidCredentials,

    #[error("Username too short")]
    UsernameTooShort,

    #[error("Email already exists")]
    EmailAlreadyExists,

    #[error("Username already taken")]
    UsernameAlreadyTaken,

    #[error("Account is banned")]
    AccountBanned,

    #[error("Invalid or expired token")]
    InvalidToken,

    #[error("User not found")]
    UserNotFound,

    #[error("Password must be at least 8 characters")]
    WeakPassword,

    #[error("Invalid language code (must be vi, en, or ja)")]
    InvalidLanguage,

    #[error("Admin account cannot be self-deleted")]
    CannotDeleteAdmin,

    #[error(transparent)]
    Internal(#[from] anyhow::Error),
}

impl ResponseError for AuthError {
    fn status_code(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            AuthError::InvalidCredentials | AuthError::InvalidToken => StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED,
            AuthError::AccountBanned => StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,
            AuthError::UserNotFound => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,
            AuthError::UsernameTooShort
            | AuthError::WeakPassword
            | AuthError::InvalidLanguage
            | AuthError::CannotDeleteAdmin => StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
            AuthError::EmailAlreadyExists | AuthError::UsernameAlreadyTaken => StatusCode::CONFLICT,
            AuthError::Internal(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    fn error_response(&self) -> HttpResponse {
        HttpResponse::build(self.status_code()).json(json!({ "error": self.to_string() }))
    }
}

use crate::infrastructure::database::models::entities::User;

pub trait AuthRepository: Send + Sync {

    fn update_password(&self, id: Uuid, hashed_password: &str) -> Result<User>;

===== FILE: backend/src/domains/auth/service.rs =====
use std::sync::Arc;

use chrono::Utc;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    domains::{
        auth::{error::AuthError, repository::AuthRepository},
        user::repository::UserRepository,
    },
    infrastructure::{
        database::models::entities::User,
        helper::auth::{
            jwt::create_token,
            password::{hash_password, verify_password},
        },
    },
};

const MIN_USERNAME_LEN: usize = 3;
const MIN_PASSWORD_LEN: usize = 8;
const VALID_LANGUAGES: &[&str] = &["vi", "en", "ja"];

pub struct AuthService {
    auth_repo: Arc<dyn AuthRepository>,
    user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
    jwt_key: String,
    jwt_expiry_hours: i64,
}

impl AuthService {
    pub fn new(
        auth_repo: Arc<dyn AuthRepository>,
        user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
        jwt_key: String,
        jwt_expiry_hours: i64,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            auth_repo,
            user_repo,
            jwt_key,
            jwt_expiry_hours,
        }
    }

    pub fn register(
        &self,
        username: &str,
        email: &str,
        native: &str,
        language: &str,
        password: &str,
    ) -> Result<User, AuthError> {
        if username.len() < MIN_USERNAME_LEN {
            return Err(AuthError::UsernameTooShort);
        }
        if password.len() < MIN_PASSWORD_LEN {
            return Err(AuthError::WeakPassword);
        }
        if !VALID_LANGUAGES.contains(&native) {
            return Err(AuthError::InvalidLanguage);
        }
        if !VALID_LANGUAGES.contains(&language) {
            return Err(AuthError::InvalidLanguage);
        }
        if self.user_repo.find_by_email(email)?.is_some() {
            return Err(AuthError::EmailAlreadyExists);
        }
        if self.user_repo.find_by_username(username)?.is_some() {
            return Err(AuthError::UsernameAlreadyTaken);
        }

        let hashed = hash_password(password)?;
        let now = Utc::now();
        let user = User {
            id: Uuid::nil(),
            username: username.into(),
            email: email.into(),
            institute: None,
            address: None,
            password: hashed,
            native: native.into(),
            language: language.into(),
            avatar_url: None,
            bio: None,
            role: "user".into(),
            status: "active".into(),
            created_at: now,
            updated_at: now,
            muted_until: None,
            token_version: 0,
        };

        Ok(self.auth_repo.create(&user)?)
    }

    pub fn login(&self, email: &str, password: &str) -> Result<(User, String), AuthError> {
        let user = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_email(email)?
            .ok_or(AuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;

        if !verify_password(password, &user.password) {
            return Err(AuthError::InvalidCredentials);
        }

        if user.status == "banned" {
            return Err(AuthError::AccountBanned);
        }

        let token = create_token(
            user.id,
            user.role.clone(),
            user.token_version,
            &self.jwt_key,
            self.jwt_expiry_hours,
        )?;

        Ok((user, token))
    }

    pub fn authenticate(&self, token: &str) -> Result<User, AuthError> {
        let claims = crate::infrastructure::helper::auth::jwt::verify_token(token, &self.jwt_key)
            .map_err(|_| AuthError::InvalidToken)?;

        let user = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(claims.sub)?
            .ok_or(AuthError::UserNotFound)?;

        if claims.ver != user.token_version {
            return Err(AuthError::InvalidToken);
        }

        match user.status.as_str() {
            "active" => Ok(user),
            "banned" => Err(AuthError::AccountBanned),
            _ => Err(AuthError::InvalidToken),
        }
    }

    pub fn logout(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), AuthError> {
        self.user_repo
            .find_by_id(user_id)?
            .ok_or(AuthError::UserNotFound)?;

        self.auth_repo.increment_token_version(user_id)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn change_password(
        &self,
        user_id: Uuid,
        current_password: &str,
        new_password: &str,
    ) -> Result<(), AuthError> {
        let user = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(user_id)?
            .ok_or(AuthError::UserNotFound)?;

        if !verify_password(current_password, &user.password) {
            return Err(AuthError::InvalidCredentials);
        }

        if new_password.len() < MIN_PASSWORD_LEN {
            return Err(AuthError::WeakPassword);
        }

        let hashed = hash_password(new_password)?;
        self.auth_repo.update_password(user_id, &hashed)?;
        self.auth_repo.increment_token_version(user_id)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn delete_account(&self, user_id: Uuid, password: &str) -> Result<(), AuthError> {
        let user = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(user_id)?
            .ok_or(AuthError::UserNotFound)?;

        if !verify_password(password, &user.password) {
            return Err(AuthError::InvalidCredentials);
        }

        if user.role == "admin" {
            return Err(AuthError::CannotDeleteAdmin);
        }

        self.auth_repo.delete(user_id)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum BookmarkError {
    #[error("Post is not available")]
    PostUnavailable,

    #[error("Bookmark not found")]
    NotFound,

    #[error("Post already bookmarked")]
    AlreadyBookmarked,

    #[error(transparent)]
    Internal(#[from] anyhow::Error),
}

impl ResponseError for BookmarkError {
    fn status_code(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            BookmarkError::PostUnavailable | BookmarkError::NotFound => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,
            BookmarkError::AlreadyBookmarked => StatusCode::CONFLICT,
            BookmarkError::Internal(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    fn error_response(&self) -> HttpResponse {
        HttpResponse::build(self.status_code()).json(json!({ "error": self.to_string() }))
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/domains/bookmark/service.rs =====
use std::sync::Arc;

use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    domains::{
        bookmark::{error::BookmarkError, repository::BookmarkRepository},
        post::repository::PostRepository,
    },
    infrastructure::database::models::{entities::Post, relations::bookmark::Bookmark},
};

pub struct BookmarkService {
    bookmark_repo: Arc<dyn BookmarkRepository>,
    post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
}

impl BookmarkService {
    pub fn new(
        bookmark_repo: Arc<dyn BookmarkRepository>,
        post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            bookmark_repo,
            post_repo,
        }
    }

    pub fn add(&self, user_id: Uuid, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Bookmark, BookmarkError> {
        self.post_repo
            .find_published_by_id(post_id)?
            .ok_or(BookmarkError::PostUnavailable)?;

        if self
            .bookmark_repo
            .find_by_user_and_post(user_id, post_id)?
            .is_some()
        {
            return Err(BookmarkError::AlreadyBookmarked);
        }

        Ok(self.bookmark_repo.create(user_id, post_id)?)
    }

    pub fn remove(&self, user_id: Uuid, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), BookmarkError> {
        if self
            .bookmark_repo
            .find_by_user_and_post(user_id, post_id)?
            .is_none()
        {
            return Err(BookmarkError::NotFound);
        }
        Ok(self.bookmark_repo.delete(user_id, post_id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_my(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>, BookmarkError> {
        Ok(self.bookmark_repo.list_bookmarked_posts(user_id)?)
    }

    pub fn is_bookmarked(&self, user_id: Uuid, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<bool, BookmarkError> {
        Ok(self
            .bookmark_repo
            .find_by_user_and_post(user_id, post_id)?
            .is_some())
    }
}

use actix_web::{HttpResponse, ResponseError, http::StatusCode};
use serde_json::json;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum CommentError {
    #[error("Comment not found")]
    NotFound,

    #[error("Content cannot be empty")]
    EmptyContent,

    #[error("Content too long")]
    ContentTooLong,

    #[error("Invalid status")]
    InvalidStatus,

    #[error("Not allowed")]
    Forbidden,

    #[error("Post is locked")]
    PostLocked,

    #[error("User not found")]
    UserNotFound,

    #[error("Post is not available")]
    PostUnavailable,

    #[error("Parent comment is not available")]
    ParentUnavailable,

    #[error("Requires moderator or admin role")]
    RequiresStaff,

    #[error(transparent)]
    Internal(#[from] anyhow::Error),
}

impl ResponseError for CommentError {
    fn status_code(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            CommentError::NotFound
            | CommentError::UserNotFound
            | CommentError::PostUnavailable
            | CommentError::ParentUnavailable => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,

            CommentError::EmptyContent
            | CommentError::ContentTooLong
            | CommentError::InvalidStatus => StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,

            CommentError::Forbidden | CommentError::PostLocked | CommentError::RequiresStaff => {
                StatusCode::FORBIDDEN
            }

            CommentError::Internal(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    fn error_response(&self) -> HttpResponse {
        HttpResponse::build(self.status_code()).json(json!({
            "error": self.to_string(),
        }))
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/domains/comment/service.rs =====
use std::sync::Arc;

use chrono::Utc;
use uuid::Uuid;
use whichlang::{Lang, detect_language};

use crate::{
    domains::{
        comment::{error::CommentError, repository::CommentRepository},
        post::repository::PostRepository,
        user::repository::UserRepository,
    },
    infrastructure::database::models::entities::Comment,
};

pub struct CommentService {
    comment_repo: Arc<dyn CommentRepository>,
    post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
    user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
}

impl CommentService {
    pub fn new(
        comment_repo: Arc<dyn CommentRepository>,
        post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
        user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            comment_repo,
            post_repo,
            user_repo,
        }
    }

    fn ensure_post_mutable(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), CommentError> {
        let post = self
            .post_repo
            .find_by_id(post_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::PostUnavailable)?;

        if post.deleted_at.is_some() || post.status != "published" {
            return Err(CommentError::PostUnavailable);
        }
        if post.comments_locked {
            return Err(CommentError::PostLocked);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn ensure_post_readable(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), CommentError> {
        let post = self
            .post_repo
            .find_by_id(post_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::PostUnavailable)?;

        if post.deleted_at.is_some() || post.status != "published" {
            return Err(CommentError::PostUnavailable);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn create(
        &self,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        post_id: Uuid,
        parent_id: Option<Uuid>,
        content: &str,
    ) -> Result<Comment, CommentError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::UserNotFound)?;

        let content = content.trim();

        if content.is_empty() {
            return Err(CommentError::EmptyContent);
        }

        if content.len() > 10_000 {
            return Err(CommentError::ContentTooLong);
        }

        self.ensure_post_mutable(post_id)?;

        if let Some(parent_id) = parent_id {
            let parent = self
                .comment_repo
                .find_by_id(parent_id)?
                .ok_or(CommentError::ParentUnavailable)?;

            if parent.post_id != post_id
                || parent.deleted_at.is_some()
                || parent.status != "visible"
            {
                return Err(CommentError::ParentUnavailable);
            }
        }

        let detected_language = match detect_language(content) {
            Lang::Vie => "vi",
            Lang::Jpn => "ja",
            Lang::Eng => "en",
            _ => "vi",
        }
        .to_string();

        let now = Utc::now();

        let comment = Comment {
            id: Uuid::nil(),
            parent_id,
            post_id,
            user_id: requester.id,
            content: content.to_string(),
            language: detected_language,
            status: "visible".into(),
            created_at: now,
            updated_at: now,
            deleted_at: None,
        };

        Ok(self.comment_repo.create(&comment)?)
    }

    fn get_active(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Comment, CommentError> {
        let comment = self
            .comment_repo
            .find_by_id(id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::NotFound)?;
        if comment.deleted_at.is_some() {
            return Err(CommentError::NotFound);
        }
        Ok(comment)
    }

    pub fn get_any(&self, id: Uuid, requester_id: Uuid) -> Result<Comment, CommentError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::UserNotFound)?;

        if !matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin") {
            return Err(CommentError::RequiresStaff);
        }

        self.comment_repo
            .find_by_id(id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::NotFound)
    }

    pub fn update_content(
        &self,
        id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        content: &str,
    ) -> Result<Comment, CommentError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::UserNotFound)?;
        let mut comment = self.get_active(id)?;

        self.ensure_post_mutable(comment.post_id)?;

        if comment.user_id != requester.id {
            return Err(CommentError::Forbidden);
        }

        let content = content.trim();

        if content.is_empty() {
            return Err(CommentError::EmptyContent);
        }
        if content.len() > 10_000 {
            return Err(CommentError::ContentTooLong);
        }

        comment.content = content.to_string();

        let detected_language = match detect_language(content) {
            Lang::Vie => "vi",
            Lang::Jpn => "ja",
            Lang::Eng => "en",
            _ => "vi",
        }
        .to_string();

        comment.language = detected_language;
        comment.updated_at = Utc::now();

        Ok(self.comment_repo.update_content(&comment)?)
    }

    pub fn update_status(
        &self,
        id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        status: &str,
    ) -> Result<Comment, CommentError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::UserNotFound)?;

        if !matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin") {
            return Err(CommentError::RequiresStaff);
        }

        if !matches!(status, "visible" | "hidden") {
            return Err(CommentError::InvalidStatus);
        }

        let comment = self.get_active(id)?;
        Ok(self.comment_repo.update_status(comment.id, status)?)
    }

    pub fn delete(&self, id: Uuid, requester_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), CommentError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::UserNotFound)?;
        let comment = self.get_active(id)?;

        self.ensure_post_mutable(comment.post_id)?;

        let is_owner = comment.user_id == requester.id;
        let is_staff = matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin");

        if !is_owner && !is_staff {
            return Err(CommentError::Forbidden);
        }

        self.comment_repo.delete(id)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn restore(&self, id: Uuid, requester_id: Uuid) -> Result<Comment, CommentError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::UserNotFound)?;

        if !matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin") {
            return Err(CommentError::RequiresStaff);
        }

        let comment = self
            .comment_repo
            .find_by_id(id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::NotFound)?;

        if comment.deleted_at.is_none() {
            return Err(CommentError::NotFound);
        }

        Ok(self.comment_repo.restore(id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_visible_by_post(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Comment>, CommentError> {
        self.ensure_post_readable(post_id)?;
        Ok(self.comment_repo.find_visible_by_post(post_id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_all_by_post(
        &self,
        post_id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Comment>, CommentError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::UserNotFound)?;

        if !matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin") {
            return Err(CommentError::RequiresStaff);
        }

        Ok(self.comment_repo.find_by_post(post_id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_my_comments(&self, author_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Comment>, CommentError> {
        let author = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(author_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::UserNotFound)?;
        Ok(self.comment_repo.find_by_author(author.id)?)
    }

    pub fn get_visible(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Comment, CommentError> {
        let comment = self
            .comment_repo
            .find_by_id(id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::NotFound)?;

        if comment.deleted_at.is_some() || comment.status != "visible" {
            return Err(CommentError::NotFound);
        }

        self.ensure_post_readable(comment.post_id)
            .map_err(|_| CommentError::NotFound)?;

        Ok(comment)
    }

    pub fn get_owned(&self, id: Uuid, owner_id: Uuid) -> Result<Comment, CommentError> {
        let owner = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(owner_id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::UserNotFound)?;

        let comment = self
            .comment_repo
            .find_by_id(id)?
            .ok_or(CommentError::NotFound)?;
        if comment.user_id != owner.id {
            return Err(CommentError::NotFound);
        }
        Ok(comment)
    }
}

use actix_web::{HttpResponse, ResponseError, http::StatusCode};
use serde_json::json;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum FollowError {
    #[error("User not found")]
    UserNotFound,

    #[error("Cannot follow yourself")]
    CannotFollowSelf,

    #[error("Already following this user")]
    AlreadyFollowing,

    #[error("Not following this user")]
    NotFollowing,

    #[error(transparent)]
    Internal(#[from] anyhow::Error),
}

impl ResponseError for FollowError {
    fn status_code(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            FollowError::UserNotFound => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,
            FollowError::CannotFollowSelf => StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
            FollowError::AlreadyFollowing | FollowError::NotFollowing => StatusCode::CONFLICT,
            FollowError::Internal(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    fn error_response(&self) -> HttpResponse {
        HttpResponse::build(self.status_code()).json(json!({ "error": self.to_string() }))
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/domains/follow/service.rs =====
use std::sync::Arc;

use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    domains::{
        follow::{error::FollowError, repository::FollowRepository},
        user::repository::UserRepository,
    },
    infrastructure::database::models::{entities::User, relations::follow::UserFollow},
};

pub struct FollowService {
    follow_repo: Arc<dyn FollowRepository>,
    user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
}

impl FollowService {
    pub fn new(follow_repo: Arc<dyn FollowRepository>, user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>) -> Self {
        Self {
            follow_repo,
            user_repo,
        }
    }

    pub fn follow(&self, follower_id: Uuid, following_id: Uuid) -> Result<UserFollow, FollowError> {
        if follower_id == following_id {
            return Err(FollowError::CannotFollowSelf);
        }
        self.user_repo
            .find_by_id(following_id)?
            .ok_or(FollowError::UserNotFound)?;
        if self.follow_repo.is_following(follower_id, following_id)? {
            return Err(FollowError::AlreadyFollowing);
        }
        Ok(self.follow_repo.follow(follower_id, following_id)?)
    }

    pub fn unfollow(&self, follower_id: Uuid, following_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), FollowError> {
        if !self.follow_repo.is_following(follower_id, following_id)? {
            return Err(FollowError::NotFollowing);
        }
        Ok(self.follow_repo.unfollow(follower_id, following_id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_followers(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<User>, FollowError> {
        self.user_repo
            .find_by_id(user_id)?
            .ok_or(FollowError::UserNotFound)?;
        Ok(self.follow_repo.list_followers(user_id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_following(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<User>, FollowError> {
        self.user_repo
            .find_by_id(user_id)?
            .ok_or(FollowError::UserNotFound)?;
        Ok(self.follow_repo.list_following(user_id)?)
    }

    pub fn stats(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<(i64, i64), FollowError> {
        self.user_repo
            .find_by_id(user_id)?
            .ok_or(FollowError::UserNotFound)?;
        Ok((
            self.follow_repo.follower_count(user_id)?,
            self.follow_repo.following_count(user_id)?,
        ))
    }

    pub fn is_following(&self, follower_id: Uuid, following_id: Uuid) -> Result<bool, FollowError> {
        Ok(self.follow_repo.is_following(follower_id, following_id)?)
    }

    pub fn is_followed_by(&self, user_id: Uuid, follower_id: Uuid) -> Result<bool, FollowError> {
        Ok(self.follow_repo.is_following(follower_id, user_id)?)
    }
}

use actix_web::{HttpResponse, ResponseError, http::StatusCode};
use serde_json::json;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum NotificationError {
    #[error("Notification not found")]
    NotFound,

    #[error("User not found")]
    UserNotFound,

    #[error("Post not found")]
    PostNotFound,

    #[error("Invalid notification kind")]
    InvalidKind,

    #[error("Requires moderator or admin role")]
    RequiresStaff,

    #[error("Not allowed")]
    Forbidden,

    #[error("Cannot notify yourself")]
    CannotNotifySelf,

    #[error("Invalid link (must start with '/' and be at most 500 chars)")]
    InvalidLink,

    #[error("Context missing for this kind")]
    MissingContext,

    #[error(transparent)]
    Internal(#[from] anyhow::Error),
}

impl ResponseError for NotificationError {
    fn status_code(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            NotificationError::NotFound
            | NotificationError::UserNotFound
            | NotificationError::PostNotFound => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,
            NotificationError::InvalidKind
            | NotificationError::CannotNotifySelf
            | NotificationError::InvalidLink
            | NotificationError::MissingContext => StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
            NotificationError::RequiresStaff | NotificationError::Forbidden => {
                StatusCode::FORBIDDEN
            }
            NotificationError::Internal(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    fn error_response(&self) -> HttpResponse {
        HttpResponse::build(self.status_code()).json(json!({ "error": self.to_string() }))
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/domains/notification/service.rs =====
use std::sync::Arc;

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    domains::{
        follow::repository::FollowRepository,
        notification::{error::NotificationError, repository::NotificationRepository},
        post::repository::PostRepository,
        user::repository::UserRepository,
    },
    infrastructure::database::models::entities::Notification,
};

const MAX_LINK_LEN: usize = 500;
const MAX_TITLE_PREVIEW_CHARS: usize = 60;

const VALID_KINDS: &[&str] = &[
    "follow",
    "reaction",
    "comment",
    "reply",
    "muted",
    "banned",
    "post_locked",
    "post_removed",
];

const STAFF_ONLY_KINDS: &[&str] = &["muted", "banned", "post_locked", "post_removed"];

const SELF_NOTIFY_BLOCKED_KINDS: &[&str] = &["follow", "reaction", "comment", "reply"];

pub struct NotificationContext {
    pub emoji: Option<String>,
    pub post_title: Option<String>,
    pub muted_until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
}

pub struct NotificationService {
    notification_repo: Arc<dyn NotificationRepository>,
    user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
    post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
    follow_repo: Arc<dyn FollowRepository>,
}

impl NotificationService {
    pub fn new(
        notification_repo: Arc<dyn NotificationRepository>,
        user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
        post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
        follow_repo: Arc<dyn FollowRepository>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            notification_repo,
            user_repo,
            post_repo,
            follow_repo,
        }
    }

    pub fn create_by_actor(
        &self,
        actor_id: Uuid,
        kind: &str,
        target_user_id: Uuid,
        link: &str,
        context: Option<NotificationContext>,
    ) -> Result<Notification, NotificationError> {
        if !VALID_KINDS.contains(&kind) {
            return Err(NotificationError::InvalidKind);
        }

        if !link.starts_with('/') || link.len() > MAX_LINK_LEN {
            return Err(NotificationError::InvalidLink);
        }

        if SELF_NOTIFY_BLOCKED_KINDS.contains(&kind) && target_user_id == actor_id {
            return Err(NotificationError::CannotNotifySelf);
        }

        let actor = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(actor_id)?
            .ok_or(NotificationError::UserNotFound)?;

        if target_user_id != actor_id && self.user_repo.find_by_id(target_user_id)?.is_none() {
            return Err(NotificationError::UserNotFound);
        }

        if STAFF_ONLY_KINDS.contains(&kind) && !matches!(actor.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin")
        {
            return Err(NotificationError::RequiresStaff);
        }

        let message = build_message(kind, &actor.username, context.as_ref())?;

        Ok(self
            .notification_repo
            .create(target_user_id, Some(actor_id), kind, &message, link)?)
    }

    pub fn fanout_post_created(
        &self,
        post_id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<i64, NotificationError> {
        let post = self
            .post_repo
            .find_by_id(post_id)?
            .ok_or(NotificationError::PostNotFound)?;

        if post.deleted_at.is_some() || post.status != "published" {
            return Err(NotificationError::PostNotFound);
        }

        if post.author_id != requester_id {
            return Err(NotificationError::Forbidden);
        }

        let recipient_ids: Vec<Uuid> = self
            .follow_repo
            .list_follower_ids(post.author_id)?
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|id| *id != post.author_id)
            .collect();

        if recipient_ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(0);
        }

        let author = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(post.author_id)?
            .ok_or(NotificationError::UserNotFound)?;

        let preview = truncate(&post.title, MAX_TITLE_PREVIEW_CHARS);
        let message = format!("New post from {}: \"{}\"", author.username, preview);
        let link = format!("/posts/{}", post_id);

        let n = self.notification_repo.create_bulk(
            &recipient_ids,
            Some(requester_id),
            "post_created",
            &message,
            &link,
        )?;
        Ok(n as i64)
    }

    pub fn list(
        &self,
        user_id: Uuid,
        limit: Option<i64>,
        offset: Option<i64>,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Notification>, NotificationError> {
        let limit = limit.unwrap_or(20).clamp(1, 100);
        let offset = offset.unwrap_or(0).max(0);
        Ok(self
            .notification_repo
            .list_by_user(user_id, limit, offset)?)
    }

    pub fn unread_count(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<i64, NotificationError> {
        Ok(self.notification_repo.count_unread(user_id)?)
    }

    pub fn mark_read(
        &self,
        user_id: Uuid,
        notification_id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<Notification, NotificationError> {
        self.notification_repo
            .mark_read(notification_id, user_id)?
            .ok_or(NotificationError::NotFound)
    }

    pub fn mark_all_read(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<usize, NotificationError> {
        Ok(self.notification_repo.mark_all_read(user_id)?)
    }

    pub fn delete(&self, user_id: Uuid, notification_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), NotificationError> {
        let deleted = self.notification_repo.delete(notification_id, user_id)?;
        if deleted == 0 {
            return Err(NotificationError::NotFound);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn build_message(
    kind: &str,
    actor_username: &str,
    ctx: Option<&NotificationContext>,
) -> Result<String, NotificationError> {
    let msg = match kind {
        "follow" => format!("{} started following you", actor_username),

        "reaction" => {
            let emoji = ctx
                .and_then(|c| c.emoji.as_deref())
                .ok_or(NotificationError::MissingContext)?;
            format!("{} reacted {} to your post", actor_username, emoji)
        }

        "comment" => format!("{} commented on your post", actor_username),

        "reply" => format!("{} replied to your comment", actor_username),

        "muted" => {
            let until = ctx
                .and_then(|c| c.muted_until)
                .ok_or(NotificationError::MissingContext)?;
            format!("Your account has been muted until {}", until.to_rfc3339())
        }

        "banned" => "Your account has been banned".to_string(),

        "post_locked" => "Comments on your post have been locked".to_string(),

        "post_removed" => {
            let title = ctx
                .and_then(|c| c.post_title.as_deref())
                .map(|t| truncate(t, MAX_TITLE_PREVIEW_CHARS))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "your post".to_string());
            format!("Your post \"{}\" has been removed", title)
        }

        _ => return Err(NotificationError::InvalidKind),
    };
    Ok(msg)
}

fn truncate(s: &str, max: usize) -> String {
    let count = s.chars().count();
    if count <= max {
        s.to_string()
    } else {
        let mut out: String = s.chars().take(max).collect();
        out.push('…');
        out
    }
}


===== FILE: backend/src/domains/post/error.rs =====
use actix_web::{HttpResponse, ResponseError, http::StatusCode};
use serde_json::json;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum PostError {
    #[error("Post not found")]
    NotFound,

    #[error("Title cannot be empty")]
    EmptyTitle,

    #[error("Title too long")]
    TitleTooLong,

    #[error("Content too long")]
    ContentTooLong,

    #[error("Invalid status")]
    InvalidStatus,

    #[error("Not allowed")]
    Forbidden,

    #[error("Post is hidden, cannot edit")]
    HiddenCannotEdit,

    #[error("user not found")]
    UserNotFound,

    #[error(
        "Invalid location: latitude and longitude must be both present or both absent, latitude in [-90,90], longitude in [-180,180]"
    )]
    InvalidLocation,

    #[error("Search query is too long (max 200 characters)")]
    QueryTooLong,

    #[error(transparent)]
    Internal(#[from] anyhow::Error),
}

impl ResponseError for PostError {
    fn status_code(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            PostError::UserNotFound | PostError::NotFound => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,

            PostError::EmptyTitle
            | PostError::TitleTooLong
            | PostError::ContentTooLong
            | PostError::InvalidLocation
            | PostError::InvalidStatus
            | PostError::QueryTooLong => StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,

            PostError::Forbidden | PostError::HiddenCannotEdit => StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,

            PostError::Internal(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    fn error_response(&self) -> HttpResponse {
        HttpResponse::build(self.status_code()).json(json!({
            "error": self.to_string(),
        }))
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/domains/post/repository.rs =====
use anyhow::Result;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::infrastructure::database::models::entities::Post;

pub trait PostRepository: Send + Sync {
    fn create(&self, post: &Post) -> Result<Post>;
