===== FILE: backend/src/domains/post/service.rs =====
use std::sync::Arc;

use chrono::Utc;
use uuid::Uuid;
use whichlang::{Lang, detect_language};

use crate::{
    domains::{
        post::{error::PostError, repository::PostRepository},
        user::repository::UserRepository,
    },
    infrastructure::database::models::entities::Post,
};

pub struct PostService {
    post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
    user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
}

impl PostService {
    pub fn new(post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>, user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>) -> Self {
        Self {
            post_repo,
            user_repo,
        }
    }

    pub fn create(
        &self,
        author_id: Uuid,
        title: &str,
        content: &str,
        latitude: Option<f64>,
        longitude: Option<f64>,
    ) -> Result<Post, PostError> {
        let title = title.trim();
        if title.is_empty() {
            return Err(PostError::EmptyTitle);
        }
        if title.len() > 255 {
            return Err(PostError::TitleTooLong);
        }
        if content.len() > 100_000 {
            return Err(PostError::ContentTooLong);
        }

        let text_to_detect = format!("{} {}", title, content);

        let detected_language = match detect_language(&text_to_detect) {
            Lang::Vie => "vi",
            Lang::Jpn => "ja",
            Lang::Eng => "en",
            _ => "vi",
        }
        .to_string();

        let now = Utc::now();
        let post = Post {
            id: Uuid::nil(),
            author_id,
            title: title.to_string(),
            content: content.to_string(),
            language: detected_language,
            latitude,
            longitude,
            status: "published".into(),
            comments_locked: false,
            created_at: now,
            updated_at: now,
            deleted_at: None,
        };

        Ok(self.post_repo.create(&post)?)
    }

    fn get_active(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Post, PostError> {
        let post = self.post_repo.find_by_id(id)?.ok_or(PostError::NotFound)?;
        if post.deleted_at.is_some() {
            return Err(PostError::NotFound);
        }
        Ok(post)
    }

    pub fn get_published(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Post, PostError> {
        self.post_repo
            .find_published_by_id(id)?
            .ok_or(PostError::NotFound)
    }

    pub fn get_owned(&self, id: Uuid, owner_id: Uuid) -> Result<Post, PostError> {
        let post = self.get_active(id)?;
        let owner = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(owner_id)?
            .ok_or(PostError::NotFound)?;

        if post.author_id != owner.id {
            return Err(PostError::NotFound);
        }

        Ok(post)
    }

    pub fn get_any(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Post, PostError> {
        self.post_repo.find_by_id(id)?.ok_or(PostError::NotFound)
    }

    pub fn update_content(
        &self,
        id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        title: &str,
        content: &str,
    ) -> Result<Post, PostError> {
        let mut post = self.get_active(id)?;
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(PostError::UserNotFound)?;

        if post.author_id != requester.id {
            return Err(PostError::Forbidden);
        }

        if post.status == "hidden" {
            return Err(PostError::HiddenCannotEdit);
        }

        let title = title.trim();
        if title.is_empty() {
            return Err(PostError::EmptyTitle);
        }
        if title.len() > 255 {
            return Err(PostError::TitleTooLong);
        }
        if content.len() > 100_000 {
            return Err(PostError::ContentTooLong);
        }

        post.title = title.to_string();
        post.content = content.to_string();

        let text_to_detect = format!("{} {}", title, content);

        let detected_language = match detect_language(&text_to_detect) {
            Lang::Vie => "vi",
            Lang::Jpn => "ja",
            Lang::Eng => "en",
            _ => "vi",
        }
        .to_string();

        post.language = detected_language;

        post.updated_at = Utc::now();

        Ok(self.post_repo.update_content(&post)?)
    }

    pub fn update_status(
        &self,
        id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        status: &str,
    ) -> Result<Post, PostError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(PostError::Forbidden)?;

        if !matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin") {
            return Err(PostError::Forbidden);
        }

        match status {
            "hidden" | "published" => {}
            _ => return Err(PostError::InvalidStatus),
        }

        let post = self.post_repo.find_by_id(id)?.ok_or(PostError::NotFound)?;
        if post.deleted_at.is_some() {
            return Err(PostError::NotFound);
        }

        Ok(self.post_repo.update_status(id, status)?)
    }

    pub fn delete(&self, id: Uuid, requester_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), PostError> {
        let post = self.get_active(id)?;
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(PostError::UserNotFound)?;

        let is_owner = post.author_id == requester.id;
        let is_staff = matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin");

        if !is_owner && !is_staff {
            return Err(PostError::Forbidden);
        }

        Ok(self.post_repo.delete(id)?)
    }

    pub fn restore(&self, post_id: Uuid, requester_id: Uuid) -> Result<Post, PostError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(PostError::UserNotFound)?;

        if !matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin") {
            return Err(PostError::Forbidden);
        }

        let post = self
            .post_repo
            .find_by_id(post_id)?
            .ok_or(PostError::NotFound)?;
        if post.deleted_at.is_none() {
            return Err(PostError::NotFound);
        }

        Ok(self.post_repo.restore(post_id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_my_posts(&self, author_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>, PostError> {
        Ok(self.post_repo.find_by_author(author_id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_published_by_author(&self, author_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>, PostError> {
        Ok(self.post_repo.find_published_by_author(author_id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_deleted(&self, author_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>, PostError> {
        Ok(self.post_repo.find_deleted_by_author(author_id)?)
    }

    pub fn search(
        &self,
        query: Option<&str>,
        tag_ids: &[Uuid],
        limit: Option<i64>,
        offset: Option<i64>,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Post>, PostError> {
        Ok(self.post_repo.search_published(
            query.map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()),
            tag_ids,
            limit.unwrap_or(20).clamp(1, 50),
            offset.unwrap_or(0).max(0),
        )?)
    }

    pub fn set_comments_locked(
        &self,
        post_id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        locked: bool,
    ) -> Result<Post, PostError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(PostError::UserNotFound)?;

        let post = self.get_active(post_id)?;

        let is_owner = post.author_id == requester.id;
        let is_staff = matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin");

        if !is_owner && !is_staff {
            return Err(PostError::Forbidden);
        }

        Ok(self.post_repo.set_comments_locked(post_id, locked)?)
    }

    pub fn list_newest_posts(&self) -> Result<Vec<Post>, PostError> {
        let mut posts = self.post_repo.list_newest_posts()?;
        posts.truncate(3);
        Ok(posts)
    }

    pub fn list_popular_posts(&self) -> Result<Vec<Post>, PostError> {
        let mut posts = self.post_repo.list_popular_posts()?;
        posts.truncate(3);
        Ok(posts)
    }

    pub fn list_following_user_posts(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>, PostError> {
        let mut posts = self.post_repo.list_following_user_posts(user_id)?;
        posts.truncate(3);
        Ok(posts)
    }

    pub fn list_question_and_answer_posts(&self) -> Result<Vec<Post>, PostError> {
        let mut posts = self.post_repo.list_question_and_answer_posts()?;
        posts.truncate(3);
        Ok(posts)
    }
}

use actix_web::{HttpResponse, ResponseError, http::StatusCode};
use serde_json::json;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum ReactionError {
    #[error("Reaction not found")]
    NotFound,

    #[error("Post is not available")]
    PostUnavailable,

    #[error("Emoji cannot be empty")]
    EmptyEmoji,

    #[error("Emoji too long")]
    EmojiTooLong,

    #[error(transparent)]
    Internal(#[from] anyhow::Error),
}

impl ResponseError for ReactionError {
    fn status_code(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            ReactionError::NotFound | ReactionError::PostUnavailable => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,
            ReactionError::EmptyEmoji | ReactionError::EmojiTooLong => StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
            ReactionError::Internal(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    fn error_response(&self) -> HttpResponse {
        HttpResponse::build(self.status_code()).json(json!({ "error": self.to_string() }))
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/domains/reaction/service.rs =====
use std::sync::Arc;

use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    domains::{
        post::repository::PostRepository,
        reaction::{error::ReactionError, repository::ReactionRepository},
    },
    infrastructure::database::models::relations::reaction::Reaction,
};

const MAX_EMOJI_CHARS: usize = 32;

pub struct ReactionService {
    reaction_repo: Arc<dyn ReactionRepository>,
    post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
}

impl ReactionService {
    pub fn new(
        reaction_repo: Arc<dyn ReactionRepository>,
        post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            reaction_repo,
            post_repo,
        }
    }

    fn ensure_post_available(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), ReactionError> {
        self.post_repo
            .find_published_by_id(post_id)?
            .ok_or(ReactionError::PostUnavailable)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn upsert(
        &self,
        user_id: Uuid,
        post_id: Uuid,
        emoji: &str,
    ) -> Result<Reaction, ReactionError> {
        let emoji = emoji.trim();
        if emoji.is_empty() {
            return Err(ReactionError::EmptyEmoji);
        }
        if emoji.chars().count() > MAX_EMOJI_CHARS {
            return Err(ReactionError::EmojiTooLong);
        }

        self.ensure_post_available(post_id)?;
        Ok(self.reaction_repo.upsert(user_id, post_id, emoji)?)
    }

    pub fn remove(&self, user_id: Uuid, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), ReactionError> {
        if self
            .reaction_repo
            .find_by_user_and_post(user_id, post_id)?
            .is_none()
        {
            return Err(ReactionError::NotFound);
        }
        Ok(self.reaction_repo.delete(user_id, post_id)?)
    }

    pub fn get_mine(
        &self,
        user_id: Uuid,
        post_id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<Option<Reaction>, ReactionError> {
        self.ensure_post_available(post_id)?;
        Ok(self.reaction_repo.find_by_user_and_post(user_id, post_id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_by_post(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Reaction>, ReactionError> {
        self.ensure_post_available(post_id)?;
        Ok(self.reaction_repo.list_by_post(post_id)?)
    }

    pub fn summary_by_post(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<(String, i64)>, ReactionError> {
        self.ensure_post_available(post_id)?;
        Ok(self.reaction_repo.summary_by_post(post_id)?)
    }
}

use actix_web::{HttpResponse, ResponseError, http::StatusCode};
use serde_json::json;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum TagError {
    #[error("Tag not found")]
    NotFound,

    #[error("Post is not available")]
    PostUnavailable,

    #[error("Tag already attached to this post")]
    AlreadyAttached,

    #[error("Tag is not attached to this post")]
    NotAttached,

    #[error("Not allowed")]
    Forbidden,

    #[error(transparent)]
    Internal(#[from] anyhow::Error),
}

impl ResponseError for TagError {
    fn status_code(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            TagError::NotFound | TagError::PostUnavailable => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,
            TagError::AlreadyAttached | TagError::NotAttached => StatusCode::CONFLICT,
            TagError::Forbidden => StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,
            TagError::Internal(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    fn error_response(&self) -> HttpResponse {
        HttpResponse::build(self.status_code()).json(json!({
            "error": self.to_string(),
        }))
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/domains/tag/service.rs =====
use std::sync::Arc;

use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    domains::{
        post::repository::PostRepository,
        tag::{error::TagError, repository::TagRepository},
    },
    infrastructure::database::models::entities::{Post, Tag},
};

pub struct TagService {
    tag_repo: Arc<dyn TagRepository>,
    post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
}

impl TagService {
    pub fn new(tag_repo: Arc<dyn TagRepository>, post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>) -> Self {
        Self {
            tag_repo,
            post_repo,
        }
    }

    pub fn list_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Tag>, TagError> {
        Ok(self.tag_repo.find_all()?)
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Tag, TagError> {
        self.tag_repo.find_by_id(id)?.ok_or(TagError::NotFound)
    }

    pub fn list_by_post(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Tag>, TagError> {
        self.post_repo
            .find_published_by_id(post_id)?
            .ok_or(TagError::PostUnavailable)?;
        Ok(self.tag_repo.list_tags_by_post(post_id)?)
    }

    pub fn list_published_posts(&self, tag_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>, TagError> {
        self.get(tag_id)?;
        let post_ids = self.tag_repo.list_post_ids_by_tag(tag_id)?;
        if post_ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(vec![]);
        }
        Ok(self.post_repo.find_published_by_ids(&post_ids)?)
    }

    pub fn attach(&self, post_id: Uuid, tag_id: Uuid, requester_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), TagError> {
        self.ensure_owner(post_id, requester_id)?;

        if self.tag_repo.find_by_id(tag_id)?.is_none() {
            return Err(TagError::NotFound);
        }
        if self.tag_repo.is_attached(post_id, tag_id)? {
            return Err(TagError::AlreadyAttached);
        }

        Ok(self.tag_repo.attach(post_id, tag_id)?)
    }

    pub fn detach(&self, post_id: Uuid, tag_id: Uuid, requester_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), TagError> {
        self.ensure_owner(post_id, requester_id)?;

        if !self.tag_repo.is_attached(post_id, tag_id)? {
            return Err(TagError::NotAttached);
        }

        Ok(self.tag_repo.detach(post_id, tag_id)?)
    }

    fn ensure_owner(&self, post_id: Uuid, requester_id: Uuid) -> Result<(), TagError> {
        let post = self
            .post_repo
            .find_by_id(post_id)?
            .ok_or(TagError::PostUnavailable)?;

        if post.deleted_at.is_some() {
            return Err(TagError::PostUnavailable);
        }
        if post.author_id != requester_id {
            return Err(TagError::Forbidden);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}


===== FILE: backend/src/domains/translation/client.rs =====
use async_trait::async_trait;

use super::error::TranslationError;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct TranslateField {
    pub key: String,
    pub text: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct TranslateRequest {
    pub source_lang: String,
    pub target_lang: String,
    pub fields: Vec<TranslateField>,
    pub context: Option<String>,
}

impl TranslateRequest {
    pub fn post(source_lang: &str, target_lang: &str, title: &str, content: &str) -> Self {
        let mut fields = Vec::with_capacity(2);
        if !title.trim().is_empty() {
            fields.push(TranslateField {
                key: "title".into(),
                text: title.into(),
            });
        }
        if !content.trim().is_empty() {
            fields.push(TranslateField {
                key: "content".into(),
                text: content.into(),
            });
        }
        Self {
            source_lang: source_lang.into(),
            target_lang: target_lang.into(),
            fields,
            context: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn comment(
        source_lang: &str,
        target_lang: &str,
        content: &str,
        context: Option<String>,
    ) -> Self {
        let mut fields = Vec::with_capacity(1);
        if !content.trim().is_empty() {
            fields.push(TranslateField {
                key: "content".into(),
                text: content.into(),
            });
        }
        Self {
            source_lang: source_lang.into(),
            target_lang: target_lang.into(),
            fields,
            context,
        }
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.fields.is_empty()
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct TranslatedField {
    pub key: String,
    pub text: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct TranslateResult {
    pub fields: Vec<TranslatedField>,
}

impl TranslateResult {
    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<&str> {
        self.fields
            .iter()
            .find(|f| f.key == key)
            .map(|f| f.text.as_str())
    }

    pub fn validate_against(&self, req: &TranslateRequest) -> Result<(), TranslationError> {
        for f in &req.fields {
            match self.get(&f.key) {
                Some(t) if !t.trim().is_empty() => {}
                _ => return Err(TranslationError::UpstreamBadResponse),
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[async_trait]
pub trait TranslationClient: Send + Sync {
    async fn translate(&self, req: TranslateRequest) -> Result<TranslateResult, TranslationError>;
}


===== FILE: backend/src/domains/translation/error.rs =====
use actix_web::{HttpResponse, ResponseError, http::StatusCode};
use serde_json::json;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum TranslationError {
    #[error("Post not found")]
    PostNotFound,

    #[error("Comment not found")]
    CommentNotFound,

    #[error("User not found")]
    UserNotFound,

    #[error("Translation service is not configured")]
    NotConfigured,

    #[error("Content is too long to translate (max {0} characters)")]
    ContentTooLong(usize),

    #[error("Translation upstream timed out")]
    UpstreamTimeout,

    #[error("Translation upstream is unavailable")]
    UpstreamUnavailable,

    #[error("Translation upstream returned an invalid response")]
    UpstreamBadResponse,

    #[error(transparent)]
    Internal(#[from] anyhow::Error),
}

impl ResponseError for TranslationError {
    fn status_code(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            TranslationError::PostNotFound
            | TranslationError::CommentNotFound
            | TranslationError::UserNotFound => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,

            TranslationError::ContentTooLong(_) => StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,

            TranslationError::NotConfigured | TranslationError::UpstreamUnavailable => {
                StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
            }

            TranslationError::UpstreamTimeout => StatusCode::GATEWAY_TIMEOUT,

            TranslationError::UpstreamBadResponse => StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,

            TranslationError::Internal(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    fn error_response(&self) -> HttpResponse {
        HttpResponse::build(self.status_code()).json(json!({ "error": self.to_string() }))
    }
}

use anyhow::Result;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::infrastructure::database::models::entities::{CommentTranslation, PostTranslation};

pub trait TranslationRepository: Send + Sync {
    fn find_post_translation(
        &self,
        post_id: Uuid,
        language: &str,
    ) -> Result<Option<PostTranslation>>;

    fn find_comment_translation(

        comment_id: Uuid,
        language: &str,
        content: &str,
    ) -> Result<CommentTranslation>;
}


===== FILE: backend/src/domains/translation/service.rs =====
use std::sync::Arc;

use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::domains::{
    comment::repository::CommentRepository,
    post::repository::PostRepository,
    translation::{
        client::{TranslateRequest, TranslationClient},
        error::TranslationError,
        repository::TranslationRepository,
    },
    user::repository::UserRepository,
};

pub const MAX_TRANSLATE_CONTENT_CHARS: usize = 15_000;
const MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS: usize = 2_000;

pub struct TranslatedPost {
    pub language: String,
    pub source_language: String,
    pub title: String,
    pub content: String,
    pub translated: bool,
}

pub struct TranslatedComment {
    pub language: String,
    pub source_language: String,
    pub content: String,
    pub translated: bool,
}

pub struct TranslationService {
    user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
    post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
    comment_repo: Arc<dyn CommentRepository>,
    translation_repo: Arc<dyn TranslationRepository>,
    client: Option<Arc<dyn TranslationClient>>,
}

impl TranslationService {
    pub fn new(
        user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
        post_repo: Arc<dyn PostRepository>,
        comment_repo: Arc<dyn CommentRepository>,
        translation_repo: Arc<dyn TranslationRepository>,
        client: Option<Arc<dyn TranslationClient>>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            user_repo,
            post_repo,
            comment_repo,
            translation_repo,
            client,
        }
    }

    fn client(&self) -> Result<&Arc<dyn TranslationClient>, TranslationError> {
        self.client.as_ref().ok_or(TranslationError::NotConfigured)
    }

    pub async fn translate_post(
        &self,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        post_id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<TranslatedPost, TranslationError> {
        let user = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(TranslationError::UserNotFound)?;

        let post = self
            .post_repo
            .find_published_by_id(post_id)?
            .ok_or(TranslationError::PostNotFound)?;

        let source_language = post.language.clone();
        let target_language = user.language.clone();

        if source_language == target_language {
            return Ok(TranslatedPost {
                language: target_language,
                source_language,
                title: post.title.clone(),
                content: post.content.clone(),
                translated: false,
            });
        }

        if let Some(t) = self
            .translation_repo
            .find_post_translation(post_id, &target_language)?
        {
            return Ok(TranslatedPost {
                language: t.language,
                source_language,
                title: t.title,
                content: t.content,
                translated: true,
            });
        }

        if post.content.chars().count() > MAX_TRANSLATE_CONTENT_CHARS
            || post.title.chars().count() > MAX_TRANSLATE_CONTENT_CHARS
        {
            return Err(TranslationError::ContentTooLong(
                MAX_TRANSLATE_CONTENT_CHARS,
            ));
        }

        let req = TranslateRequest::post(
            &source_language,
            &target_language,
            &post.title,
            &post.content,
        );

        if req.is_empty() {
            return Ok(TranslatedPost {
                language: target_language,
                source_language,
                title: post.title.clone(),
                content: post.content.clone(),
                translated: false,
            });
        }

        let client = self.client()?;
        let result = client.translate(req.clone()).await?;
        result.validate_against(&req)?;

        let title_out = result
            .get("title")
            .map(str::to_owned)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| post.title.clone());
        let content_out = result
            .get("content")
            .map(str::to_owned)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| post.content.clone());

        let row = self.translation_repo.upsert_post_translation(
            post_id,
            &target_language,
            &title_out,
            &content_out,
        )?;

        Ok(TranslatedPost {
            language: row.language,
            source_language,
            title: row.title,
            content: row.content,
            translated: true,
        })
    }

    pub async fn translate_comment(
        &self,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        comment_id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<TranslatedComment, TranslationError> {
        let user = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(TranslationError::UserNotFound)?;

        let comment = self
            .comment_repo
            .find_by_id(comment_id)?
            .filter(|c| c.deleted_at.is_none() && c.status == "visible")
            .ok_or(TranslationError::CommentNotFound)?;

        let post = self
            .post_repo
            .find_published_by_id(comment.post_id)?
            .ok_or(TranslationError::PostNotFound)?;

        let source_language = comment.language.clone();
        let target_language = user.language.clone();

        if source_language == target_language {
            return Ok(TranslatedComment {
                language: target_language,
                source_language,
                content: comment.content.clone(),
                translated: false,
            });
        }

        if let Some(t) = self
            .translation_repo
            .find_comment_translation(comment_id, &target_language)?
        {
            return Ok(TranslatedComment {
                language: t.language,
                source_language,
                content: t.content,
                translated: true,
            });
        }

        if comment.content.chars().count() > MAX_TRANSLATE_CONTENT_CHARS {
            return Err(TranslationError::ContentTooLong(
                MAX_TRANSLATE_CONTENT_CHARS,
            ));
        }

        let mut context = format!("Post title: {}", post.title);
        if let Some(parent_id) = comment.parent_id
            && let Some(parent) = self.comment_repo.find_by_id(parent_id)?
            && parent.deleted_at.is_none()
        {
            let snippet = truncate_chars(&parent.content, MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS);
            context.push_str(&format!("\nParent comment: {}", snippet));
        }
        let context = truncate_chars(&context, MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS);

        let req = TranslateRequest::comment(
            &source_language,
            &target_language,
            &comment.content,
            Some(context),
        );

        if req.is_empty() {
            return Ok(TranslatedComment {
                language: target_language,
                source_language,
                content: comment.content.clone(),
                translated: false,
            });
        }

        let client = self.client()?;
        let result = client.translate(req.clone()).await?;
        result.validate_against(&req)?;

        let content_out = result
            .get("content")
            .map(str::to_owned)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| comment.content.clone());

        let row = self.translation_repo.upsert_comment_translation(
            comment_id,
            &target_language,
            &content_out,
        )?;

        Ok(TranslatedComment {
            language: row.language,
            source_language,
            content: row.content,
            translated: true,
        })
    }
}

fn truncate_chars(s: &str, max: usize) -> String {
    if s.chars().count() <= max {
        s.to_string()
    } else {
        s.chars().take(max).collect()
    }
}


===== FILE: backend/src/domains/user/error.rs =====
use actix_web::{HttpResponse, ResponseError, http::StatusCode};
use serde_json::json;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum UserError {
    #[error("User not found")]
    NotFound,

    #[error("Invalid credentials")]
    InvalidCredentials,

    #[error("Username too short")]
    UsernameTooShort,

    #[error("Invalid status")]
    InvalidStatus,

    #[error("Invalid role")]
    InvalidRole,

    #[error("Invalid language code (must be vi, en, or ja)")]
    InvalidLanguage,

    #[error("Email already exists")]
    EmailAlreadyExists,

    #[error("Username already taken")]
    UsernameAlreadyTaken,

    #[error("Email already taken")]
    EmailAlreadyTaken,

    #[error("You can only edit your own profile")]
    ForbiddenProfileEdit,

    #[error("Cannot modify a user with equal or higher role")]
    CannotModifyHigherRole,

    #[error("Cannot ban yourself")]
    CannotBanSelf,

    #[error("Cannot mute yourself")]
    CannotMuteSelf,

    #[error("Cannot change your own role")]
    CannotChangeOwnRole,

    #[error("Cannot assign admin role")]
    CannotAssignAdminRole,

    #[error("Requires admin role")]
    RequiresAdmin,

    #[error("Requires moderator or admin role")]
    RequiresStaff,

    #[error("Account is banned")]
    AccountBanned,

    #[error("Invalid or expired token")]
    InvalidToken,

    #[error(transparent)]
    Internal(#[from] anyhow::Error),
}

impl ResponseError for UserError {
    fn status_code(&self) -> StatusCode {
        match self {
            UserError::NotFound => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,
            UserError::InvalidCredentials => StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED,

            UserError::UsernameTooShort
            | UserError::InvalidStatus
            | UserError::InvalidRole
            | UserError::InvalidLanguage
            | UserError::InvalidToken => StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,

            UserError::EmailAlreadyExists
            | UserError::UsernameAlreadyTaken
            | UserError::EmailAlreadyTaken => StatusCode::CONFLICT,

            UserError::ForbiddenProfileEdit
            | UserError::CannotModifyHigherRole
            | UserError::CannotBanSelf
            | UserError::CannotMuteSelf
            | UserError::CannotChangeOwnRole
            | UserError::CannotAssignAdminRole
            | UserError::RequiresAdmin
            | UserError::RequiresStaff
            | UserError::AccountBanned => StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,

            UserError::Internal(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        }
    }

    fn error_response(&self) -> HttpResponse {
        HttpResponse::build(self.status_code()).json(json!({
            "error": self.to_string(),
        }))
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/domains/user/service.rs =====
use std::sync::Arc;

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    domains::user::{error::UserError, repository::UserRepository},
    infrastructure::database::models::entities::User,
};

const MIN_USERNAME_LEN: usize = 3;
const VALID_LANGUAGES: &[&str] = &["vi", "en", "ja"];

pub struct UserService {
    user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>,
}

impl UserService {
    pub fn new(user_repo: Arc<dyn UserRepository>) -> Self {
        Self { user_repo }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<User, UserError> {
        self.user_repo.find_by_id(id)?.ok_or(UserError::NotFound)
    }

    pub fn find_by_email(&self, email: &str) -> Result<Option<User>, UserError> {
        Ok(self.user_repo.find_by_email(email)?)
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn update_profile(
        &self,
        target_id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        username: Option<String>,
        email: Option<String>,
        native: Option<String>,
        language: Option<String>,
        institute: Option<String>,
        address: Option<String>,
        bio: Option<String>,
        avatar_url: Option<String>,
    ) -> Result<User, UserError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(UserError::NotFound)?;

        if requester.id != target_id {
            return Err(UserError::ForbiddenProfileEdit);
        }

        let mut user = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(target_id)?
            .ok_or(UserError::NotFound)?;

        if let Some(new_username) = username
            && new_username != user.username
        {
            if new_username.len() < MIN_USERNAME_LEN {
                return Err(UserError::UsernameTooShort);
            }
            if self.user_repo.find_by_username(&new_username)?.is_some() {
                return Err(UserError::UsernameAlreadyTaken);
            }
            user.username = new_username;
        }

        if let Some(new_email) = email
            && new_email != user.email
        {
            if self.user_repo.find_by_email(&new_email)?.is_some() {
                return Err(UserError::EmailAlreadyTaken);
            }
            user.email = new_email;
        }

        if let Some(institute) = institute {
            user.institute = Some(institute);
        }

        if let Some(address) = address {
            user.address = Some(address);
        }

        if let Some(native) = native {
            if !VALID_LANGUAGES.contains(&native.as_str()) {
                return Err(UserError::InvalidLanguage);
            }
            user.native = native;
        }

        if let Some(language) = language {
            if !VALID_LANGUAGES.contains(&language.as_str()) {
                return Err(UserError::InvalidLanguage);
            }
            user.language = language;
        }

        if let Some(bio) = bio {
            user.bio = Some(bio);
        }

        if let Some(avatar_url) = avatar_url {
            user.avatar_url = Some(avatar_url);
        }

        Ok(self.user_repo.update_profile(&user)?)
    }

    pub fn update_status(
        &self,
        target_id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        status: &str,
    ) -> Result<User, UserError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(UserError::NotFound)?;

        let target = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(target_id)?
            .ok_or(UserError::NotFound)?;

        let valid = ["active", "banned"];

        if !valid.contains(&status) {
            return Err(UserError::InvalidStatus);
        }

        if !matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin") {
            return Err(UserError::RequiresStaff);
        }

        let can_modify = match requester.role.as_str() {
            "admin" => target.role != "admin",
            "moderator" => target.role == "user",
            _ => false,
        };

        if !can_modify {
            return Err(UserError::CannotModifyHigherRole);
        }

        if target_id == requester_id && status == "banned" {
            return Err(UserError::CannotBanSelf);
        }

        Ok(self.user_repo.update_status(target_id, status)?)
    }

    pub fn update_role(
        &self,
        target_id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        new_role: &str,
    ) -> Result<User, UserError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(UserError::NotFound)?;

        let target = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(target_id)?
            .ok_or(UserError::NotFound)?;

        if new_role == "admin" {
            return Err(UserError::CannotAssignAdminRole);
        }

        if !matches!(new_role, "user" | "moderator") {
            return Err(UserError::InvalidRole);
        }

        if requester.role.as_str() != "admin" {
            return Err(UserError::RequiresAdmin);
        }

        if target.id == requester_id {
            return Err(UserError::CannotChangeOwnRole);
        }

        if target.role.as_str() == "admin" {
            return Err(UserError::CannotModifyHigherRole);
        }

        Ok(self.user_repo.update_role(target_id, new_role)?)
    }

    pub fn update_mute(
        &self,
        target_id: Uuid,
        requester_id: Uuid,
        muted_until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
    ) -> Result<User, UserError> {
        let requester = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(requester_id)?
            .ok_or(UserError::NotFound)?;

        let target = self
            .user_repo
            .find_by_id(target_id)?
            .ok_or(UserError::NotFound)?;

        if !matches!(requester.role.as_str(), "moderator" | "admin") {
            return Err(UserError::RequiresStaff);
        }

        let can_modify = match requester.role.as_str() {
            "admin" => target.role != "admin",
            "moderator" => target.role == "user",
            _ => false,
        };

        if !can_modify {
            return Err(UserError::CannotModifyHigherRole);
        }

        if target_id == requester_id && muted_until.is_some() {
            return Err(UserError::CannotMuteSelf);
        }

        Ok(self.user_repo.update_muted_until(target_id, muted_until)?)
    }
}

use crate::infrastructure::database::schema::bookmarks;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use diesel::{Insertable, Queryable, Selectable};
use uuid::Uuid;

#[derive(Debug, Queryable, Selectable)]
#[diesel(table_name = bookmarks)]
#[diesel(check_for_backend(diesel::pg::Pg))]

use anyhow::Result;
use chrono::Utc;
use diesel::prelude::*;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::pool::DbPool,
    domains::auth::repository::AuthRepository,
    infrastructure::database::{
        models::entities::{NewUser, User},
        schema::users,
    },
};

pub struct PostgresAuthRepo {
    pool: DbPool,
}

impl PostgresAuthRepo {
    pub fn new(pool: DbPool) -> Self {
        Self { pool }
    }
}

impl AuthRepository for PostgresAuthRepo {
    fn create(&self, user: &User) -> Result<User> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let new_user = NewUser {
            username: &user.username,
            email: &user.email,
            password: &user.password,
            native: &user.native,
            language: &user.language,
            role: &user.role,
            status: &user.status,
        };

        Ok(diesel::insert_into(users::table)
            .values(&new_user)
            .returning(User::as_select())
            .get_result::<User>(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn update_password(&self, id: Uuid, hashed_password: &str) -> Result<User> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(diesel::update(users::table.find(id))
            .set((
                users::password.eq(hashed_password),
                users::updated_at.eq(Utc::now()),
            ))
            .returning(User::as_select())
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn increment_token_version(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<i32> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(diesel::update(users::table.find(id))
            .set((
                users::token_version.eq(users::token_version + 1),
                users::updated_at.eq(Utc::now()),
            ))
            .returning(users::token_version)
            .get_result::<i32>(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn delete(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        diesel::delete(users::table.find(id)).execute(&mut conn)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}


===== FILE: backend/src/infrastructure/database/repositories/bookmark_repo.rs =====
use anyhow::Result;
use diesel::prelude::*;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::pool::DbPool,
    domains::bookmark::repository::BookmarkRepository,
    infrastructure::database::{
        models::{
            entities::Post,
            relations::bookmark::{Bookmark, NewBookmark},
        },
        schema::{bookmarks, posts},
    },
};

pub struct PostgresBookmarkRepo {
    pool: DbPool,
}

impl PostgresBookmarkRepo {
    pub fn new(pool: DbPool) -> Self {
        Self { pool }
    }
}

impl BookmarkRepository for PostgresBookmarkRepo {
    fn find_by_user_and_post(&self, user_id: Uuid, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Option<Bookmark>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(bookmarks::table
            .filter(bookmarks::user_id.eq(user_id))
            .filter(bookmarks::post_id.eq(post_id))
            .select(Bookmark::as_select())
            .first(&mut conn)
            .optional()?)
    }

    fn create(&self, user_id: Uuid, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Bookmark> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let new = NewBookmark { user_id, post_id };
        Ok(diesel::insert_into(bookmarks::table)
            .values(&new)
            .returning(Bookmark::as_returning())
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn delete(&self, user_id: Uuid, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        diesel::delete(
            bookmarks::table
                .filter(bookmarks::user_id.eq(user_id))
                .filter(bookmarks::post_id.eq(post_id)),
        )
        .execute(&mut conn)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn list_bookmarked_posts(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let post_ids: Vec<Uuid> = bookmarks::table
            .filter(bookmarks::user_id.eq(user_id))
            .order(bookmarks::bookmarked_at.desc())
            .select(bookmarks::post_id)
            .load(&mut conn)?;

        if post_ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(vec![]);
        }

        let posts = posts::table
            .filter(posts::id.eq_any(&post_ids))
            .filter(posts::status.eq("published"))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_null())
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .load::<Post>(&mut conn)?;

        let mut map: HashMap<Uuid, Post> = posts.into_iter().map(|p| (p.id, p)).collect();
        Ok(post_ids
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|id| map.remove(&id))
            .collect())
    }
}


===== FILE: backend/src/infrastructure/database/repositories/comment_repo.rs =====
use anyhow::Result;
use chrono::DateTime;
use chrono::Utc;
use diesel::prelude::*;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::pool::DbPool,
    domains::comment::repository::CommentRepository,
    infrastructure::database::{
        models::entities::{Comment, NewComment},
        schema::{comment_translation, comments},
    },
};

pub struct PostgresCommentRepo {
    pool: DbPool,
}

impl PostgresCommentRepo {
    pub fn new(pool: DbPool) -> Self {
        Self { pool }
    }
}

impl CommentRepository for PostgresCommentRepo {
    fn create(&self, comment: &Comment) -> Result<Comment> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let new_comment = NewComment {
            parent_id: comment.parent_id,
            post_id: comment.post_id,
            user_id: comment.user_id,
            language: &comment.language,
            content: &comment.content,
            status: &comment.status,
        };

        let created = diesel::insert_into(comments::table)
            .values(&new_comment)
            .returning(Comment::as_returning())
            .get_result(&mut conn)?;

        Ok(created)
    }

    fn update_content(&self, comment: &Comment) -> Result<Comment> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let now = Utc::now();

        Ok(conn.transaction::<_, diesel::result::Error, _>(|conn| {
            let updated = diesel::update(comments::table.find(comment.id))
                .set((
                    comments::content.eq(&comment.content),
                    comments::language.eq(&comment.language),
                    comments::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .returning(Comment::as_returning())
                .get_result(conn)?;

            diesel::update(comment_translation::table)
                .filter(comment_translation::original_comment_id.eq(comment.id))
                .filter(comment_translation::deleted_at.is_null())
                .set((
                    comment_translation::deleted_at.eq(Some(now)),
                    comment_translation::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .execute(conn)?;

            Ok(updated)
        })?)
    }

    fn update_status(&self, id: Uuid, status: &str) -> Result<Comment> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let updated = diesel::update(comments::table.find(id))
            .set((
                comments::status.eq(status),
                comments::updated_at.eq(Utc::now()),
            ))
            .returning(Comment::as_returning())
            .get_result(&mut conn)?;

        Ok(updated)
    }

    fn delete(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        conn.transaction::<_, diesel::result::Error, _>(|conn| {
            let comment = comments::table
                .find(id)
                .select(Comment::as_select())
                .first::<Comment>(conn)
                .optional()?;

            let Some(comment) = comment else {
                return Err(diesel::result::Error::NotFound);
            };
            if comment.deleted_at.is_some() {
                return Ok(());
            }

            let now = Utc::now();
            diesel::update(comments::table.find(id))
                .set((
                    comments::deleted_at.eq(Some(now)),
                    comments::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .execute(conn)?;

            diesel::update(comment_translation::table)
                .filter(comment_translation::original_comment_id.eq(id))
                .filter(comment_translation::deleted_at.is_null())
                .set((
                    comment_translation::deleted_at.eq(Some(now)),
                    comment_translation::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .execute(conn)?;

            Ok(())
        })?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn restore(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Comment> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(conn.transaction::<_, diesel::result::Error, _>(|conn| {
            let comment = comments::table
                .find(id)
                .select(Comment::as_select())
                .first::<Comment>(conn)
                .optional()?;

            let Some(comment) = comment else {
                return Err(diesel::result::Error::NotFound);
            };
            let Some(delete_time) = comment.deleted_at else {
                return Err(diesel::result::Error::NotFound);
            };

            let now = Utc::now();

            let restored = diesel::update(comments::table.find(id))
                .set((
                    comments::deleted_at.eq(None::<DateTime<Utc>>),
                    comments::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .returning(Comment::as_returning())
                .get_result(conn)?;

            diesel::update(comment_translation::table)
                .filter(comment_translation::original_comment_id.eq(id))
                .filter(comment_translation::deleted_at.eq(delete_time))
                .set((
                    comment_translation::deleted_at.eq(None::<DateTime<Utc>>),
                    comment_translation::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .execute(conn)?;

            Ok(restored)
        })?)
    }

    fn find_by_id(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Option<Comment>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let comment = comments::table
            .find(id)
            .select(Comment::as_select())
            .first(&mut conn)
            .optional()?;

        Ok(comment)
    }

    fn find_by_post(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Comment>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let comments = comments::table
            .filter(comments::post_id.eq(post_id))
            .order(comments::created_at.asc())
            .select(Comment::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?;

        Ok(comments)
    }

    fn find_visible_by_post(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Comment>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let comments = comments::table
            .filter(comments::post_id.eq(post_id))
            .filter(comments::status.eq("visible"))
            .filter(comments::deleted_at.is_null())
            .order(comments::created_at.asc())
            .select(Comment::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?;

        Ok(comments)
    }

    fn find_by_author(&self, author_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Comment>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let comments = comments::table
            .filter(comments::user_id.eq(author_id))
            .filter(comments::deleted_at.is_null())
            .order(comments::created_at.desc())
            .select(Comment::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?;

        Ok(comments)
    }
}

use diesel::prelude::*;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::pool::DbPool,
    domains::follow::repository::FollowRepository,
    infrastructure::database::{
        models::{
            entities::User,

    pool: DbPool,

impl PostgresFollowRepo {

        Self { pool }
    }

impl FollowRepository for PostgresFollowRepo {
    fn is_following(&self, follower_id: Uuid, following_id: Uuid) -> Result<bool> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let count: i64 = users_follows::table
            .filter(users_follows::follower_id.eq(follower_id))
            .filter(users_follows::following_id.eq(following_id))
            .count()
            .get_result(&mut conn)?;
        Ok(count > 0)
    }

    fn follow(&self, follower_id: Uuid, following_id: Uuid) -> Result<UserFollow> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let new = NewUserFollow {
            follower_id,
            following_id,
        };
        Ok(diesel::insert_into(users_follows::table)
            .values(&new)
            .returning(UserFollow::as_returning())
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn unfollow(&self, follower_id: Uuid, following_id: Uuid) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        diesel::delete(
            users_follows::table
                .filter(users_follows::follower_id.eq(follower_id))
                .filter(users_follows::following_id.eq(following_id)),
        )
        .execute(&mut conn)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn list_followers(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<User>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let ids: Vec<Uuid> = users_follows::table
            .filter(users_follows::following_id.eq(user_id))
            .order(users_follows::followed_at.desc())
            .select(users_follows::follower_id)
            .load(&mut conn)?;
        if ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(vec![]);
        }
        let list = users::table
            .filter(users::id.eq_any(&ids))
            .select(User::as_select())
            .load::<User>(&mut conn)?;
        let mut map: HashMap<Uuid, User> = list.into_iter().map(|u| (u.id, u)).collect();
        Ok(ids.into_iter().filter_map(|id| map.remove(&id)).collect())
    }

    fn list_following(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<User>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let ids: Vec<Uuid> = users_follows::table
            .filter(users_follows::follower_id.eq(user_id))
            .order(users_follows::followed_at.desc())
            .select(users_follows::following_id)
            .load(&mut conn)?;
        if ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(vec![]);
        }
        let list = users::table
            .filter(users::id.eq_any(&ids))
            .select(User::as_select())
            .load::<User>(&mut conn)?;
        let mut map: HashMap<Uuid, User> = list.into_iter().map(|u| (u.id, u)).collect();
        Ok(ids.into_iter().filter_map(|id| map.remove(&id)).collect())
    }

    fn list_follower_ids(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Uuid>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(users_follows::table
            .filter(users_follows::following_id.eq(user_id))
            .select(users_follows::follower_id)
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn follower_count(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<i64> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(users_follows::table
            .filter(users_follows::following_id.eq(user_id))
            .count()
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn following_count(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<i64> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(users_follows::table
            .filter(users_follows::follower_id.eq(user_id))
            .count()
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/infrastructure/database/repositories/notification_repo.rs =====
use anyhow::Result;
use diesel::prelude::*;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::pool::DbPool,
    domains::notification::repository::NotificationRepository,
    infrastructure::database::{
        models::entities::{NewNotification, Notification},
        schema::notifications,
    },
};

pub struct PostgresNotificationRepo {
    pool: DbPool,
}

impl PostgresNotificationRepo {
    pub fn new(pool: DbPool) -> Self {
        Self { pool }
    }
}

impl NotificationRepository for PostgresNotificationRepo {
    fn create(
        &self,
        user_id: Uuid,
        actor_id: Option<Uuid>,
        kind: &str,
        message: &str,
        link: &str,
    ) -> Result<Notification> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let new = NewNotification {
            user_id,
            actor_id,
            kind,
            message,
            link,
        };
        Ok(diesel::insert_into(notifications::table)
            .values(&new)
            .returning(Notification::as_returning())
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn create_bulk(
        &self,
        user_ids: &[Uuid],
        actor_id: Option<Uuid>,
        kind: &str,
        message: &str,
        link: &str,
    ) -> Result<usize> {
        if user_ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(0);
        }
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let rows: Vec<NewNotification> = user_ids
            .iter()
            .map(|uid| NewNotification {
                user_id: *uid,
                actor_id,
                kind,
                message,
                link,
            })
            .collect();

        Ok(diesel::insert_into(notifications::table)
            .values(&rows)
            .on_conflict_do_nothing()
            .execute(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn find_by_id(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Option<Notification>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(notifications::table
            .find(id)
            .select(Notification::as_select())
            .first(&mut conn)
            .optional()?)
    }

    fn list_by_user(&self, user_id: Uuid, limit: i64, offset: i64) -> Result<Vec<Notification>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(notifications::table
            .filter(notifications::user_id.eq(user_id))
            .order(notifications::created_at.desc())
            .limit(limit)
            .offset(offset)
            .select(Notification::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn count_unread(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<i64> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(notifications::table
            .filter(notifications::user_id.eq(user_id))
            .filter(notifications::is_readed.eq(false))
            .count()
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn mark_read(&self, id: Uuid, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<Option<Notification>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(diesel::update(notifications::table)
            .filter(notifications::id.eq(id))
            .filter(notifications::user_id.eq(user_id))
            .set(notifications::is_readed.eq(true))
            .returning(Notification::as_returning())
            .get_result(&mut conn)
            .optional()?)
    }

    fn mark_all_read(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<usize> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(diesel::update(notifications::table)
            .filter(notifications::user_id.eq(user_id))
            .filter(notifications::is_readed.eq(false))
            .set(notifications::is_readed.eq(true))
            .execute(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn delete(&self, id: Uuid, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<usize> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(diesel::delete(
            notifications::table
                .filter(notifications::id.eq(id))
                .filter(notifications::user_id.eq(user_id)),
        )
        .execute(&mut conn)?)
    }
}


===== FILE: backend/src/infrastructure/database/repositories/post_repo.rs =====
use anyhow::Result;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use diesel::dsl::count_star;
use diesel::prelude::*;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::pool::DbPool,
    domains::post::repository::PostRepository,
    infrastructure::database::{
        models::entities::{NewPost, Post},
        schema::{post_translation, posts, posts_tags, reactions, tags, users_follows},
    },
};

pub struct PostgresPostRepo {
    pool: DbPool,
}

impl PostgresPostRepo {
    pub fn new(pool: DbPool) -> Self {
        Self { pool }
    }
}

impl PostRepository for PostgresPostRepo {
    fn create(&self, post: &Post) -> Result<Post> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let new_post = NewPost {
            author_id: post.author_id,
            title: &post.title,
            content: &post.content,
            language: &post.language,
            latitude: post.latitude,
            longitude: post.longitude,
            status: &post.status,
        };

        Ok(diesel::insert_into(posts::table)
            .values(&new_post)
            .returning(Post::as_returning())
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn update_content(&self, post: &Post) -> Result<Post> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let now = Utc::now();

        Ok(conn.transaction::<_, diesel::result::Error, _>(|conn| {
            let updated = diesel::update(posts::table.find(post.id))
                .set((
                    posts::title.eq(&post.title),
                    posts::content.eq(&post.content),
                    posts::language.eq(&post.language),
                    posts::latitude.eq(post.latitude),
                    posts::longitude.eq(post.longitude),
                    posts::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .returning(Post::as_returning())
                .get_result(conn)?;

            diesel::update(post_translation::table)
                .filter(post_translation::original_post_id.eq(post.id))
                .filter(post_translation::deleted_at.is_null())
                .set((
                    post_translation::deleted_at.eq(Some(now)),
                    post_translation::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .execute(conn)?;

            Ok(updated)
        })?)
    }

    fn update_status(&self, id: Uuid, status: &str) -> Result<Post> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(diesel::update(posts::table.find(id))
            .set((posts::status.eq(status), posts::updated_at.eq(Utc::now())))
            .returning(Post::as_returning())
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn delete(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        conn.transaction::<_, diesel::result::Error, _>(|conn| {
            let post = posts::table
                .find(id)
                .select(Post::as_select())
                .first::<Post>(conn)
                .optional()?;

            let Some(post) = post else {
                return Err(diesel::result::Error::NotFound);
            };
            if post.deleted_at.is_some() {
                return Ok(());
            }

            let now = Utc::now();

            diesel::update(posts::table.find(id))
                .set((posts::deleted_at.eq(Some(now)), posts::updated_at.eq(now)))
                .execute(conn)?;

            diesel::update(post_translation::table)
                .filter(post_translation::original_post_id.eq(id))
                .filter(post_translation::deleted_at.is_null())
                .set((
                    post_translation::deleted_at.eq(Some(now)),
                    post_translation::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .execute(conn)?;

            Ok(())
        })?;

        Ok(())
    }

    fn restore(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Post> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(conn.transaction::<_, diesel::result::Error, _>(|conn| {
            let post = posts::table
                .find(id)
                .select(Post::as_select())
                .first::<Post>(conn)
                .optional()?;

            let Some(post) = post else {
                return Err(diesel::result::Error::NotFound);
            };
            let Some(delete_time) = post.deleted_at else {
                return Err(diesel::result::Error::NotFound);
            };

            let now = Utc::now();

            let restored = diesel::update(posts::table.find(id))
                .set((
                    posts::deleted_at.eq(None::<DateTime<Utc>>),
                    posts::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .returning(Post::as_returning())
                .get_result(conn)?;

            diesel::update(post_translation::table)
                .filter(post_translation::original_post_id.eq(id))
                .filter(post_translation::deleted_at.eq(delete_time))
                .set((
                    post_translation::deleted_at.eq(None::<DateTime<Utc>>),
                    post_translation::updated_at.eq(now),
                ))
                .execute(conn)?;

            Ok(restored)
        })?)
    }

    fn find_by_id(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Option<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(posts::table
            .find(id)
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .first(&mut conn)
            .optional()?)
    }

    fn find_published_by_id(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Option<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(posts::table
            .find(id)
            .filter(posts::status.eq("published"))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_null())
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .first(&mut conn)
            .optional()?)
    }

    fn find_by_author(&self, author_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(posts::table
            .filter(posts::author_id.eq(author_id))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_null())
            .order(posts::created_at.desc())
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn find_published_by_author(&self, author_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(posts::table
            .filter(posts::author_id.eq(author_id))
            .filter(posts::status.eq("published"))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_null())
            .order(posts::created_at.desc())
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn find_deleted_by_author(&self, author_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(posts::table
            .filter(posts::author_id.eq(author_id))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_not_null())
            .order(posts::deleted_at.desc())
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn find_published_by_ids(&self, ids: &[Uuid]) -> Result<Vec<Post>> {
        if ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(vec![]);
        }
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(posts::table
            .filter(posts::id.eq_any(ids))
            .filter(posts::status.eq("published"))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_null())
            .order(posts::created_at.desc())
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn set_comments_locked(&self, id: Uuid, locked: bool) -> Result<Post> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(diesel::update(posts::table.find(id))
            .set((
                posts::comments_locked.eq(locked),
                posts::updated_at.eq(Utc::now()),
            ))
            .returning(Post::as_returning())
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn search_published(
        &self,
        query: Option<&str>,
        tag_ids: &[Uuid],
        limit: i64,
        offset: i64,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let mut tag_ids = tag_ids.to_vec();
        tag_ids.sort();
        tag_ids.dedup();

        let tag_filter: Option<Vec<Uuid>> = if tag_ids.is_empty() {
            None
        } else {
            let matching: Vec<Uuid> = posts_tags::table
                .filter(posts_tags::tag_id.eq_any(&tag_ids))
                .group_by(posts_tags::post_id)
                .having(count_star().eq(tag_ids.len() as i64))
                .select(posts_tags::post_id)
                .load(&mut conn)?;
            if matching.is_empty() {
                return Ok(vec![]);
            }
            Some(matching)
        };

        let mut boxed = posts::table
            .filter(posts::status.eq("published"))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_null())
            .into_boxed();

        if let Some(term) = query {
            let pattern = format!("%{}%", term);
            boxed = boxed.filter(
                posts::title
                    .ilike(pattern.clone())
                    .or(posts::content.ilike(pattern)),
            );
        }

        if let Some(ids) = tag_filter {
            boxed = boxed.filter(posts::id.eq_any(ids));
        }

        Ok(boxed
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .order(posts::created_at.desc())
            .limit(limit)
            .offset(offset)
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn list_newest_posts(&self) -> Result<Vec<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        Ok(posts::table
            .filter(posts::status.eq("published"))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_null())
            .order(posts::created_at.desc())
            .limit(20)
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn list_popular_posts(&self) -> Result<Vec<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let ranked: Vec<(Uuid, i64)> = posts::table
            .inner_join(reactions::table)
            .filter(posts::status.eq("published"))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_null())
            .group_by(posts::id)
            .select((posts::id, count_star()))
            .order(count_star().desc())
            .limit(20)
            .load(&mut conn)?;

        let ids: Vec<Uuid> = ranked.into_iter().map(|(id, _)| id).collect();
        if ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(vec![]);
        }

        let rows = posts::table
            .filter(posts::id.eq_any(&ids))
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .load::<Post>(&mut conn)?;

        let mut map: HashMap<Uuid, Post> = rows.into_iter().map(|p| (p.id, p)).collect();
        Ok(ids.into_iter().filter_map(|id| map.remove(&id)).collect())
    }

    fn list_following_user_posts(&self, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let following_ids: Vec<Uuid> = users_follows::table
            .filter(users_follows::follower_id.eq(user_id))
            .select(users_follows::following_id)
            .load(&mut conn)?;

        if following_ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(vec![]);
        }

        Ok(posts::table
            .filter(posts::author_id.eq_any(&following_ids))
            .filter(posts::status.eq("published"))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_null())
            .order(posts::created_at.desc())
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn list_question_and_answer_posts(&self) -> Result<Vec<Post>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;

        let question_tag: Option<Uuid> = tags::table
            .filter(tags::name.eq("question"))
            .select(tags::id)
            .first(&mut conn)
            .optional()?;

        let Some(tag_id) = question_tag else {
            return Ok(vec![]);
        };

        Ok(posts::table
            .inner_join(posts_tags::table)
            .filter(posts_tags::tag_id.eq(tag_id))
            .filter(posts::status.eq("published"))
            .filter(posts::deleted_at.is_null())
            .order(posts::created_at.desc())
            .select(Post::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }
}

use chrono::Utc;
use diesel::dsl::count_star;
use diesel::prelude::*;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::pool::DbPool,
    domains::reaction::repository::ReactionRepository,
    infrastructure::database::{
        models::relations::reaction::{NewReaction, Reaction},
        schema::reactions,
    },
};

pub struct PostgresReactionRepo {
    pool: DbPool,
}

impl PostgresReactionRepo {
    pub fn new(pool: DbPool) -> Self {
        Self { pool }
    }
}

impl ReactionRepository for PostgresReactionRepo {
    fn find_by_user_and_post(&self, user_id: Uuid, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Option<Reaction>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(reactions::table
            .filter(reactions::user_id.eq(user_id))
            .filter(reactions::post_id.eq(post_id))
            .select(Reaction::as_select())
            .first(&mut conn)
            .optional()?)
    }

    fn list_by_post(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Reaction>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(reactions::table
            .filter(reactions::post_id.eq(post_id))
            .order(reactions::reacted_at.desc())
            .select(Reaction::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn summary_by_post(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<(String, i64)>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(reactions::table
            .filter(reactions::post_id.eq(post_id))
            .group_by(reactions::emoji)
            .select((reactions::emoji, count_star()))
            .order(count_star().desc())
            .load::<(String, i64)>(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn upsert(&self, user_id: Uuid, post_id: Uuid, emoji: &str) -> Result<Reaction> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let new = NewReaction {
            user_id,
            post_id,
            emoji,
        };

        Ok(diesel::insert_into(reactions::table)
            .values(&new)
            .on_conflict((reactions::user_id, reactions::post_id))
            .do_update()
            .set((
                reactions::emoji.eq(emoji),
                reactions::reacted_at.eq(Utc::now()),
            ))
            .returning(Reaction::as_returning())
            .get_result(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn delete(&self, user_id: Uuid, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        diesel::delete(
            reactions::table
                .filter(reactions::user_id.eq(user_id))
                .filter(reactions::post_id.eq(post_id)),
        )
        .execute(&mut conn)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl TagRepository for PostgresTagRepo {
    fn find_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Tag>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(tags::table
            .order(tags::name.asc())
            .select(Tag::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn find_by_id(&self, id: Uuid) -> Result<Option<Tag>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(tags::table
            .find(id)
            .select(Tag::as_select())
            .first(&mut conn)
            .optional()?)
    }

    fn list_post_ids_by_tag(&self, tag_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Uuid>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(posts_tags::table
            .filter(posts_tags::tag_id.eq(tag_id))
            .select(posts_tags::post_id)
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn list_tags_by_post(&self, post_id: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<Tag>> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        Ok(posts_tags::table
            .inner_join(tags::table)
            .filter(posts_tags::post_id.eq(post_id))
            .order(tags::name.asc())
            .select(Tag::as_select())
            .load(&mut conn)?)
    }

    fn is_attached(&self, post_id: Uuid, tag_id: Uuid) -> Result<bool> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let count: i64 = posts_tags::table
            .filter(posts_tags::post_id.eq(post_id))
            .filter(posts_tags::tag_id.eq(tag_id))
            .count()
            .get_result(&mut conn)?;
        Ok(count > 0)
    }

    fn attach(&self, post_id: Uuid, tag_id: Uuid) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        let row = NewPostTag { post_id, tag_id };
        diesel::insert_into(posts_tags::table)
            .values(&row)
            .execute(&mut conn)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn detach(&self, post_id: Uuid, tag_id: Uuid) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = self.pool.get()?;
        diesel::delete(
            posts_tags::table
                .filter(posts_tags::post_id.eq(post_id))
                .filter(posts_tags::tag_id.eq(tag_id)),
        )
        .execute(&mut conn)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/infrastructure/helper/auth/jwt.rs =====
use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};
use chrono::{Duration, Utc};
use jsonwebtoken::{Algorithm, DecodingKey, EncodingKey, Header, Validation, decode, encode};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use uuid::Uuid;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Claims {
    pub sub: Uuid,
    pub role: String,
    pub ver: i32,
    pub exp: usize,
    pub iat: usize,
}

pub fn create_token(
    user_id: Uuid,
    role: String,
    token_version: i32,
    secret: &str,
    hours: i64,
) -> Result<String> {
    let now = Utc::now();
    let claims = Claims {
        sub: user_id,
        role,
        ver: token_version,
        exp: (now + Duration::hours(hours)).timestamp() as usize,
        iat: now.timestamp() as usize,
    };

    encode(
        &Header::new(Algorithm::HS256),
        &claims,
        &EncodingKey::from_secret(secret.as_bytes()),
    )
    .map_err(|e| anyhow!("JWT encode: {}", e))
}

pub fn verify_token(token: &str, secret: &str) -> Result<Claims> {
    let mut validation = Validation::new(Algorithm::HS256);
    validation.validate_exp = true;

    decode::<Claims>(
        token,
        &DecodingKey::from_secret(secret.as_bytes()),
        &validation,
    )
    .map(|d| d.claims)
    .map_err(|e| anyhow!("JWT verify: {}", e))
}

===== FILE: backend/src/infrastructure/helper/auth/password.rs =====
use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};
use argon2::{
    Argon2,
    password_hash::{PasswordHash, PasswordHasher, PasswordVerifier, SaltString, rand_core::OsRng},
};

pub fn hash_password(password: &str) -> Result<String> {
    let salt = SaltString::generate(&mut OsRng);
    let hash = Argon2::default()
        .hash_password(password.as_bytes(), &salt)
        .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Hash failed: {}", e))?
        .to_string();
    Ok(hash)
}

pub fn verify_password(password: &str, hash: &str) -> bool {
    match PasswordHash::new(hash) {
        Ok(parsed) => Argon2::default()
            .verify_password(password.as_bytes(), &parsed)
            .is_ok(),
        Err(_) => false,
    }
}
