===== FILE: backend/src/infrastructure/helper/translation/deepseek.rs =====
use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::json;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::config::TranslationConfig,
    domains::translation::{
        client::{TranslateRequest, TranslateResult, TranslationClient},
        error::TranslationError,
    },
    infrastructure::helper::translation::{
        build_prompt, client_model, http_client, map_reqwest_error, parse_translated,
    },
};

const DEFAULT_ENDPOINT: &str = "https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions";

pub struct DeepSeekClient {
    http: reqwest::Client,
    api_key: String,
    model: String,
    endpoint: String,
}

impl DeepSeekClient {
    pub fn from_config(cfg: &TranslationConfig) -> Result<Self> {
        Ok(Self {
            http: http_client(cfg)?,
            api_key: cfg.api_key.clone(),
            model: client_model(cfg, "deepseek"),
            endpoint: cfg
                .base_url
                .clone()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_ENDPOINT.to_string()),
        })
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl TranslationClient for DeepSeekClient {
    async fn translate(&self, req: TranslateRequest) -> Result<TranslateResult, TranslationError> {
        let (system, user) = build_prompt(&req);

        let body = json!({
            "model": self.model,
            "messages": [
                { "role": "system", "content": system },
                { "role": "user",   "content": user   },
            ],
            "temperature": 0.2,
            "response_format": { "type": "json_object" },
        });

        let resp = self
            .http
            .post(&self.endpoint)
            .bearer_auth(&self.api_key)
            .json(&body)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(map_reqwest_error)?;

        let status = resp.status();
        if !status.is_success() {
            let body = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
            tracing::warn!(%status, body = %body, "deepseek upstream error");
            return Err(if status.is_server_error() {
                TranslationError::UpstreamUnavailable
            } else {
                TranslationError::UpstreamBadResponse
            });
        }

        let parsed: ChatResponse = resp.json().await.map_err(map_reqwest_error)?;
        let content = parsed
            .choices
            .into_iter()
            .next()
            .map(|c| c.message.content)
            .ok_or(TranslationError::UpstreamBadResponse)?;

        parse_translated(&content, &req)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct ChatResponse {
    choices: Vec<Choice>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Choice {
    message: Message,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Message {
    content: String,
}


===== FILE: backend/src/infrastructure/helper/translation/gemini.rs =====
use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::json;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::config::TranslationConfig,
    domains::translation::{
        client::{TranslateRequest, TranslateResult, TranslationClient},
        error::TranslationError,
    },
    infrastructure::helper::translation::{
        build_prompt, client_model, http_client, map_reqwest_error, parse_translated,
    },
};

const DEFAULT_BASE: &str = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models";

pub struct GeminiClient {
    http: reqwest::Client,
    api_key: String,
    model: String,
    base_url: String,
}

impl GeminiClient {
    pub fn from_config(cfg: &TranslationConfig) -> Result<Self> {
        Ok(Self {
            http: http_client(cfg)?,
            api_key: cfg.api_key.clone(),
            model: client_model(cfg, "gemini"),
            base_url: cfg
                .base_url
                .clone()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_BASE.to_string()),
        })
    }

    fn endpoint(&self) -> String {
        format!(
            "{}/{}:generateContent",
            self.base_url.trim_end_matches('/'),
            self.model
        )
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl TranslationClient for GeminiClient {
    async fn translate(&self, req: TranslateRequest) -> Result<TranslateResult, TranslationError> {
        let (system, user) = build_prompt(&req);

        let body = json!({
            "systemInstruction": { "parts": [{ "text": system }] },
            "contents": [
                { "role": "user", "parts": [{ "text": user }] }
            ],
            "generationConfig": {
                "temperature": 0.2,
                "responseMimeType": "application/json"
            }
        });

        let resp = self
            .http
            .post(self.endpoint())
            .query(&[("key", self.api_key.as_str())])
            .json(&body)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(map_reqwest_error)?;

        let status = resp.status();
        if !status.is_success() {
            let body = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
            tracing::warn!(%status, body = %body, "gemini upstream error");
            return Err(if status.is_server_error() {
                TranslationError::UpstreamUnavailable
            } else {
                TranslationError::UpstreamBadResponse
            });
        }

        let parsed: GeminiResponse = resp.json().await.map_err(map_reqwest_error)?;
        let text = parsed
            .candidates
            .into_iter()
            .next()
            .and_then(|c| c.content.parts.into_iter().next())
            .map(|p| p.text)
            .ok_or(TranslationError::UpstreamBadResponse)?;

        parse_translated(&text, &req)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct GeminiResponse {
    candidates: Vec<Candidate>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Candidate {
    content: Content,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Content {
    parts: Vec<Part>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Part {
    text: String,
}


===== FILE: backend/src/infrastructure/helper/translation/mod.rs =====
pub mod deepseek;
pub mod gemini;

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};

use crate::{
    bootstrap::config::TranslationConfig,
    domains::translation::{
        client::{TranslateRequest, TranslateResult, TranslatedField, TranslationClient},
        error::TranslationError,
    },
};

pub use deepseek::DeepSeekClient;
pub use gemini::GeminiClient;

pub fn build_client(cfg: &TranslationConfig) -> Result<Option<Arc<dyn TranslationClient>>> {
    if !cfg.is_configured() {
        tracing::info!("translation: no provider configured, disabling");
        return Ok(None);
    }

    let provider = cfg.provider.trim().to_lowercase();

    let client: Arc<dyn TranslationClient> = match provider.as_str() {
        "deepseek" => Arc::new(DeepSeekClient::from_config(cfg)?),
        "gemini" => Arc::new(GeminiClient::from_config(cfg)?),
        other => {
            return Err(anyhow!(
                "unknown TRANSLATION_PROVIDER '{other}' (expected 'deepseek' or 'gemini')"
            ));
        }
    };

    tracing::info!(
        provider = %provider,
        model = %client_model(cfg, &provider),
        timeout_secs = cfg.timeout_secs,
        "translation: configured"
    );

    Ok(Some(client))
}

pub(crate) fn client_model(cfg: &TranslationConfig, provider: &str) -> String {
    if !cfg.model.trim().is_empty() {
        return cfg.model.clone();
    }
    match provider {
        "deepseek" => "deepseek-chat".into(),
        "gemini" => "gemini-2.0-flash".into(),
        _ => "default".into(),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn http_client(cfg: &TranslationConfig) -> Result<reqwest::Client> {
    Ok(reqwest::Client::builder()
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(cfg.timeout_secs.max(1)))
        .build()?)
}

pub(crate) fn map_reqwest_error(e: reqwest::Error) -> TranslationError {
    if e.is_timeout() {
        TranslationError::UpstreamTimeout
    } else if e.is_connect() || e.is_request() {
        TranslationError::UpstreamUnavailable
    } else {
        TranslationError::UpstreamBadResponse
    }
}

pub(crate) fn build_prompt(req: &TranslateRequest) -> (String, String) {
    let keys: Vec<&str> = req.fields.iter().map(|f| f.key.as_str()).collect();
    let system = format!(
        "You are a professional translator. Translate the provided fields from `{}` to `{}`. \
         Reply with a single JSON object whose keys exactly match: {}. \
         Do not add explanations, do not wrap the JSON in code fences. \
         Preserve meaning, tone, and formatting of the source.",
        req.source_lang,
        req.target_lang,
        keys.join(", "),
    );

    let mut payload = serde_json::Map::new();
    for f in &req.fields {
        payload.insert(f.key.clone(), serde_json::Value::String(f.text.clone()));
    }
    let body = serde_json::to_string(&payload).unwrap_or_else(|_| "{}".into());

    let user = match req.context.as_deref() {
        Some(ctx) if !ctx.trim().is_empty() => {
            format!("Context:\n{ctx}\n\nText (JSON):\n{body}")
        }
        _ => format!("Text (JSON):\n{body}"),
    };

    (system, user)
}

pub(crate) fn parse_translated(
    raw: &str,
    req: &TranslateRequest,
) -> Result<TranslateResult, TranslationError> {
    let cleaned = strip_code_fence(raw);
    let value: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_str(&cleaned).map_err(|_| TranslationError::UpstreamBadResponse)?;
    let obj = value
        .as_object()
        .ok_or(TranslationError::UpstreamBadResponse)?;

    let mut fields = Vec::with_capacity(req.fields.len());
    for f in &req.fields {
        let text = obj
            .get(&f.key)
            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
            .ok_or(TranslationError::UpstreamBadResponse)?;
        fields.push(TranslatedField {
            key: f.key.clone(),
            text: text.to_string(),
        });
    }
    Ok(TranslateResult { fields })
}

fn strip_code_fence(s: &str) -> String {
    let t = s.trim();
    for prefix in ["```json", "```JSON", "```"] {
        if let Some(rest) = t.strip_prefix(prefix) {
            let rest = rest.trim_start_matches(['\n', '\r']);
            let rest = rest.strip_suffix("```").unwrap_or(rest);
            return rest.trim().to_string();
        }
    }
    t.to_string()
}


===== FILE: backend/src/infrastructure/middleware.rs =====
use actix_web::{
    Error, HttpMessage,
    body::MessageBody,
    dev::{ServiceRequest, ServiceResponse},
    error::{ErrorForbidden, ErrorInternalServerError, ErrorUnauthorized},
    http::Method,
    middleware::Next,
    web,
};
use chrono::Utc;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::state::AppState, domains::auth::error::AuthError,
    presentation::dto::auth_dto::AuthUser,
};

pub async fn auth(
    req: ServiceRequest,
    next: Next<impl MessageBody>,
) -> Result<ServiceResponse<impl MessageBody>, Error> {
    let state = req
        .app_data::<web::Data<AppState>>()
        .ok_or_else(|| ErrorInternalServerError("AppState missing"))?
        .clone();

    let auth_header = req
        .headers()
        .get("Authorization")
        .and_then(|h| h.to_str().ok())
        .ok_or_else(|| ErrorUnauthorized("Missing Authorization header"))?;

    let token = auth_header
        .strip_prefix("Bearer ")
        .ok_or_else(|| ErrorUnauthorized("Invalid format"))?
        .to_string();

    let service = state.auth_service.clone();
    let user = web::block(move || service.authenticate(&token))
        .await
        .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)?
        .map_err(|e| match e {
            AuthError::InvalidToken => ErrorUnauthorized("Invalid token"),
            AuthError::UserNotFound => ErrorUnauthorized("User not found"),
            AuthError::AccountBanned => ErrorForbidden("Your account has been banned"),
            _ => ErrorInternalServerError("Authentication failure"),
        })?;

    let method = req.method().clone();
    let is_write = matches!(
        method,
        Method::POST | Method::PATCH | Method::PUT | Method::DELETE
    );

    if is_write
        && let Some(until) = user.muted_until
        && until > Utc::now()
    {
        let msg = format!(
            "Your account is muted until {}. You can still read content.",
            until.to_rfc3339()
        );
        return Err(ErrorForbidden(msg));
    }

    req.extensions_mut().insert(AuthUser {
        id: user.id,
        role: user.role,
        status: user.status,
        muted_until: user.muted_until,
    });

    next.call(req).await
}

===== FILE: backend/src/main.rs =====
use actix_governor::{Governor, GovernorConfigBuilder};
use actix_web::{App, HttpServer, middleware::Logger};
use backend::{bootstrap, cors, presentation::openapi::ApiDoc, routes};
use utoipa::OpenApi;
use utoipa_swagger_ui::SwaggerUi;

#[actix_web::main]
async fn main() -> std::io::Result<()> {
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_max_level(tracing::Level::INFO)
        .init();

    let rate_limiter = GovernorConfigBuilder::default()
        .requests_per_second(4)
        .burst_size(7)
        .finish()
        .unwrap();

    let state = bootstrap::run().expect("Bootstrap failed");
    let host = state.config.server_host.clone();
    let port = state.config.server_port;
    let origins = state.config.cors_allowed_origins.clone();

    HttpServer::new(move || {
        App::new()
            .app_data(state.clone())
            .wrap(Logger::default())
            .wrap(Governor::new(&rate_limiter))
            .wrap(cors::build(&origins))
            .service(
                SwaggerUi::new("/swagger-ui/{_:.*}")
                    .url("/api-docs/openapi.json", ApiDoc::openapi()),
            )
            .configure(routes::configure)
    })
    .bind((host.as_str(), port))?
    .run()
    .await
}

use actix_web::{
    Error, FromRequest, HttpMessage, HttpRequest, dev::Payload, error::ErrorUnauthorized,
};
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::future::{Ready, ready};
use utoipa::ToSchema;
use uuid::Uuid;

#[derive(Deserialize, ToSchema)]
pub struct RegisterRequest {
    pub username: String,
    pub email: String,
    pub password: String,
    pub native: String,
    pub language: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize, ToSchema)]
pub struct RegisterResponse {
    pub user_id: Uuid,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, ToSchema)]
pub struct LoginRequest {
    pub email: String,
    pub password: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize, ToSchema)]
pub struct LoginResponse {
    pub user_id: Uuid,
    pub token: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AuthUser {
    pub id: Uuid,
    pub role: String,
    pub status: String,
    pub muted_until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
}

impl AuthUser {
    pub fn has_role(&self, role: &str) -> bool {
        self.role == role
    }

    pub fn is_user(&self) -> bool {
        self.has_role("user")
    }

    pub fn is_staff(&self) -> bool {
        self.is_admin() || self.has_role("moderator")
    }

    pub fn is_admin(&self) -> bool {
        self.has_role("admin")
    }
}

impl FromRequest for AuthUser {
    type Error = Error;
    type Future = Ready<Result<Self, Self::Error>>;

    fn from_request(req: &HttpRequest, _: &mut Payload) -> Self::Future {
        ready(
            req.extensions()
                .get::<AuthUser>()
                .cloned()
                .ok_or_else(|| ErrorUnauthorized("Not authenticated")),
        )
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/src/presentation/handlers/auth_handler.rs =====
use actix_web::{Error, HttpResponse, error::ErrorInternalServerError, post, web};

use crate::{
    bootstrap::state::AppState,
    presentation::dto::auth_dto::{
        AuthUser, LoginRequest, LoginResponse, RegisterRequest, RegisterResponse,
    },
};

#[utoipa::path(
    post,
    path = "/api/v1/auth/register",
    tag = "auth",
    request_body = RegisterRequest,
    responses(
        (status = 201, description = "Registration successful", body = RegisterResponse),
        (status = 400, description = "Invalid payload (username too short, weak password, invalid language)"),
        (status = 409, description = "Email or username already taken"),
    ),
)]
#[post("/auth/register")]
pub async fn register(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    body: web::Json<RegisterRequest>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.auth_service.clone();
    let body = body.into_inner();

    let user = web::block(move || {
        service.register(
            &body.username,
            &body.email,
            &body.native,
            &body.native,
            &body.password,
        )
    })
    .await
    .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::Created().json(RegisterResponse { user_id: user.id }))
}

#[utoipa::path(
    post,
    path = "/api/v1/auth/login",
    tag = "auth",
    request_body = LoginRequest,
    responses(
        (status = 200, description = "Login successful", body = LoginResponse),
        (status = 401, description = "Invalid email or password"),
        (status = 403, description = "Account is banned"),
    ),
)]
#[post("/auth/login")]
pub async fn login(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    body: web::Json<LoginRequest>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.auth_service.clone();
    let body = body.into_inner();

    let (user, token) = web::block(move || service.login(&body.email, &body.password))
        .await
        .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(LoginResponse {
        user_id: user.id,
        token,
    }))
}

#[utoipa::path(
    post,
    path = "/api/v1/auth/logout",
    tag = "auth",
    responses(
        (status = 204, description = "Logged out; all previously issued tokens are invalidated"),
        (status = 401, description = "Not authenticated"),
    ),
    security(("bearer_auth" = [])),
)]
#[post("/auth/logout")]
pub async fn logout(state: web::Data<AppState>, user: AuthUser) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.auth_service.clone();
    let user_id = user.id;

    web::block(move || service.logout(user_id))
        .await
        .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::NoContent().finish())
}

===== FILE: backend/src/presentation/handlers/health_handler.rs =====
use crate::bootstrap::state::AppState;
use actix_web::{HttpResponse, Responder, get, web};

#[utoipa::path(
    get,
    path = "/health",
    tag = "system",
    responses(
        (status = 200, description = "Service healthy", body = String)
    ),
)]
#[get("/health")]
pub async fn health(state: web::Data<AppState>) -> impl Responder {
    let pool = state.pool.clone();
    match web::block(move || pool.get()).await {
        Ok(Ok(_)) => HttpResponse::Ok().body("OK"),
        _ => HttpResponse::ServiceUnavailable().body("DB unavailable"),
    }
}

use actix_web::{
    Error, HttpResponse, delete, error::ErrorInternalServerError, get, patch, post, web,
};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::state::AppState,
    presentation::dto::{
        auth_dto::AuthUser,
        notification_dto::{
            CreateNotificationRequest, ListNotificationsQuery, MarkAllReadResponse,
            NotificationResponse, NotifyFollowersResponse, UnreadCountResponse,
        },
    },
};

#[utoipa::path(
    post,
    path = "/api/v1/notifications",
    tag = "notification",
    request_body = CreateNotificationRequest,
    responses(
        (status = 201, description = "Notification created", body = NotificationResponse),
        (status = 400, description = "Invalid kind / link / missing context / self-notify"),
        (status = 401, description = "Not authenticated"),
        (status = 403, description = "Requires staff role for this kind"),
        (status = 404, description = "Target user not found"),
    ),
    security(("bearer_auth" = [])),
)]
#[post("/notifications")]
pub async fn create_notification(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    user: AuthUser,
    body: web::Json<CreateNotificationRequest>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.notification_service.clone();
    let actor_id = user.id;
    let req = body.into_inner();

    let kind = req.kind;
    let target_user_id = req.target_user_id;
    let link = req.link;
    let context = req.context.map(Into::into);

    let created = web::block(move || {
        service.create_by_actor(actor_id, &kind, target_user_id, &link, context)
    })
    .await
    .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::Created().json(NotificationResponse::from(created)))
}

    post,
    path = "/api/v1/posts/{id}/notify-followers",

    params(("id" = Uuid, Path, description = "Post ID")),
    responses(
        (status = 200, description = "Fan-out result", body = NotifyFollowersResponse),
        (status = 401, description = "Not authenticated"),
        (status = 403, description = "Only the post author can trigger fan-out"),
        (status = 404, description = "Post not found or not published"),
    ),
    security(("bearer_auth" = [])),
)]
#[post("/posts/{id}/notify-followers")]
pub async fn notify_followers(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    user: AuthUser,
    path: web::Path<Uuid>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.notification_service.clone();
    let post_id = path.into_inner();
    let requester_id = user.id;

    let notified = web::block(move || service.fanout_post_created(post_id, requester_id))
        .await
        .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(NotifyFollowersResponse { notified }))
}

    ),
    security(("bearer_auth" = [])),

#[patch("/my")]
pub async fn update_my_profile(

    body: web::Json<UpdateProfileRequest>,

            req.native,

            req.institute,
            req.address,
            req.bio,

        )
    })

    .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(GetUserResponse::from(updated)))

===== FILE: backend/src/presentation/handlers/post_handler.rs =====
use actix_web::{
    Error, HttpResponse, delete, error::ErrorInternalServerError, get, patch, post, web,
};

use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::state::AppState,
    presentation::dto::{
        auth_dto::AuthUser,
        post_dto::{CreatePostRequest, PostResponse, SearchPostsQuery, UpdatePostRequest},
    },
};

#[utoipa::path(
    post,
    path = "/api/v1/posts",
    tag = "post",
    request_body = CreatePostRequest,
    responses(
        (status = 201, description = "Post created", body = PostResponse),
        (status = 400, description = "Invalid payload"),
        (status = 401, description = "Not authenticated"),
    ),
    security(("bearer_auth" = [])),
)]
#[post("/posts")]
pub async fn create_post(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    user: AuthUser,
    body: web::Json<CreatePostRequest>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.post_service.clone();
    let req = body.into_inner();
    let author_id = user.id;

    let created = web::block(move || {
        service.create(
            author_id,
            &req.title,
            req.content.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
            req.latitude,
            req.longitude,
        )
    })
    .await
    .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::Created().json(PostResponse::from(created)))
}

#[utoipa::path(
    get,
    path = "/api/v1/posts/{id}",
    tag = "post",
    params(
        ("id" = Uuid, Path, description = "Post ID")
    ),
    responses(
        (status = 200, description = "Post details", body = PostResponse),
        (status = 404, description = "Post not found"),
    ),
)]
#[get("/posts/{id}")]
pub async fn get_post(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    path: web::Path<Uuid>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.post_service.clone();
    let post_id = path.into_inner();

    let post = web::block(move || service.get_published(post_id))
        .await
        .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(PostResponse::from(post)))
}

#[utoipa::path(
    patch,
    path = "/api/v1/posts/{id}",
    tag = "post",
    params(
        ("id" = Uuid, Path, description = "ID of the post to update")
    ),
    request_body = UpdatePostRequest,
    responses(
        (status = 200, description = "Post updated", body = PostResponse),
        (status = 400, description = "Invalid payload"),
        (status = 403, description = "Not allowed to edit this post"),
        (status = 404, description = "Post not found"),
    ),
    security(("bearer_auth" = [])),
)]
#[patch("/posts/{id}")]
pub async fn update_post(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    user: AuthUser,
    path: web::Path<Uuid>,
    body: web::Json<UpdatePostRequest>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.post_service.clone();
    let post_id = path.into_inner();
    let req = body.into_inner();
    let requester_id = user.id;

    let updated = web::block(move || {
        service.update_content(
            post_id,
            requester_id,
            &req.title,
            req.content.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
        )
    })
    .await
    .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(PostResponse::from(updated)))
}

#[utoipa::path(
    delete,
    path = "/api/v1/posts/{id}",

    params(
        ("id" = Uuid, Path, description = "ID of the post to delete")
    ),
    responses(
        (status = 204, description = "Post deleted"),
        (status = 403, description = "Not allowed to delete this post"),
        (status = 404, description = "Post not found"),
    ),
    security(("bearer_auth" = [])),
)]
#[delete("/posts/{id}")]
pub async fn delete_post(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    user: AuthUser,
    path: web::Path<Uuid>,

    let service = state.post_service.clone();
    let post_id = path.into_inner();
    let requester_id = user.id;

    Ok(HttpResponse::NoContent().finish())
}

#[utoipa::path(
    get,
    path = "/api/v1/posts",
    tag = "post",
    responses((status = 200, body = [PostResponse])),
)]
#[get("/posts")]
pub async fn search_posts(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    q: web::Query<SearchPostsQuery>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let q = q.into_inner();
    let tags: Vec<Uuid> = q
        .tags
        .as_deref()
        .unwrap_or("")
        .split(',')
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .map(Uuid::parse_str)
        .collect::<Result<_, _>>()
        .map_err(|_| actix_web::error::ErrorBadRequest("Invalid tag UUID"))?;
    let service = state.post_service.clone();
    let query = q.q;
    let posts = web::block(move || service.search(query.as_deref(), &tags, q.limit, q.offset))
        .await
        .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;
    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(
        posts
            .into_iter()
            .map(PostResponse::from)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    ))
}

#[utoipa::path(
    get,
    path = "/api/v1/posts/{post_id}/reactions/summary",

    responses(
        (status = 200, description = "Reaction counts grouped by emoji", body = [ReactionSummaryItem]),
        (status = 404, description = "Post not available"),
    ),
)]
#[get("/posts/{post_id}/reactions/summary")]
pub async fn summary_post_reactions(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    path: web::Path<Uuid>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.reaction_service.clone();
    let post_id = path.into_inner();

        .await

    let resp: Vec<ReactionSummaryItem> = summary

        .map(|(emoji, count)| ReactionSummaryItem { emoji, count })

    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(resp))

#[utoipa::path(
    get,
    path = "/api/v1/posts/{post_id}/reactions/me",
    tag = "reaction",
    params(("post_id" = Uuid, Path, description = "Post ID")),
    responses(
        (status = 200, description = "My reaction", body = ReactionResponse),
        (status = 401, description = "Not authenticated"),
        (status = 404, description = "Not reacted"),
    ),
    security(("bearer_auth" = [])),
)]
#[get("/posts/{post_id}/reactions/me")]
pub async fn get_my_reaction(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    user: AuthUser,
    path: web::Path<Uuid>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.reaction_service.clone();
    let post_id = path.into_inner();

    let reaction_opt = web::block(move || service.get_mine(user_id, post_id))
        .await

    }
}

#[utoipa::path(

    delete,
    path = "/api/v1/posts/{post_id}/tags/{tag_id}",
    tag = "tag",
    params(
        ("post_id" = Uuid, Path, description = "Post ID"),
        ("tag_id" = Uuid, Path, description = "Tag ID"),
    ),
    responses(
        (status = 204, description = "Tag detached"),
        (status = 403, description = "Not the post owner"),
        (status = 404, description = "Post not found"),
        (status = 409, description = "Tag not attached"),
    ),
    security(("bearer_auth" = [])),
)]
#[delete("/posts/{post_id}/tags/{tag_id}")]
pub async fn detach_tag(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    user: AuthUser,
    path: web::Path<(Uuid, Uuid)>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let (post_id, tag_id) = path.into_inner();
    let requester_id = user.id;
    let service = state.tag_service.clone();

    web::block(move || service.detach(post_id, tag_id, requester_id))
        .await
        .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::NoContent().finish())
}

===== FILE: backend/src/presentation/handlers/user_handler.rs =====
use actix_web::{Error, HttpResponse, error::ErrorInternalServerError, get, patch, web};

use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::{
    bootstrap::state::AppState,
    presentation::dto::{
        auth_dto::AuthUser,
        user_dto::{GetUserResponse, UpdateProfileRequest},
    },
};

#[utoipa::path(
    get,
    path = "/api/v1/users/{id}",
    tag = "user",
    params(
        ("id" = Uuid, Path, description = "User ID")
    ),
    responses(
        (status = 200, description = "User profile", body = GetUserResponse),
        (status = 404, description = "User not found"),
    ),
)]
#[get("/users/{id}")]
pub async fn get_user(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    path: web::Path<Uuid>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let service = state.user_service.clone();
    let user_id = path.into_inner();

    let user = web::block(move || service.get(user_id))
        .await
        .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(GetUserResponse::from(user)))
}

#[utoipa::path(
    patch,
    path = "/api/v1/users/{id}",
    tag = "user",
    params(
        ("id" = Uuid, Path, description = "ID of the user to update")
    ),
    request_body = UpdateProfileRequest,
    responses(
        (status = 200, description = "Profile updated", body = GetUserResponse),
        (status = 400, description = "Invalid payload"),
        (status = 403, description = "Not allowed to edit this profile"),
        (status = 404, description = "User not found"),
    ),
    security(("bearer_auth" = [])),
)]
#[patch("/users/{id}")]
pub async fn update_user(
    state: web::Data<AppState>,
    user: AuthUser,
    path: web::Path<Uuid>,
    body: web::Json<UpdateProfileRequest>,
) -> Result<HttpResponse, Error> {
    let target_id = path.into_inner();
    let requester_id = user.id;
    let req = body.into_inner();
    let service = state.user_service.clone();

    let updated = web::block(move || {
        service.update_profile(
            target_id,
            requester_id,
            req.username,
            req.email,
            req.native,
            req.language,
            req.institute,
            req.address,
            req.bio,
            req.avatar_url,
        )
    })
    .await
    .map_err(ErrorInternalServerError)??;

    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(GetUserResponse::from(updated)))
}

struct SecurityAddon;

impl Modify for SecurityAddon {
    fn modify(&self, openapi: &mut utoipa::openapi::OpenApi) {
        if let Some(components) = openapi.components.as_mut() {
            components.add_security_scheme(
                "bearer_auth",
                SecurityScheme::Http(
                    HttpBuilder::new()
                        .scheme(HttpAuthScheme::Bearer)
                        .bearer_format("JWT")
                        .build(),
                ),
            );
        }
    }
}

===== FILE: backend/tests/common/mod.rs =====
use actix_web::{App, HttpServer};
use backend::bootstrap;
use reqwest::blocking::Client;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

pub struct TestServer {
    pub base: String,
    handle: Option<actix_web::dev::ServerHandle>,
    join: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl TestServer {
    pub fn start() -> Self {
        let state = bootstrap::run().expect("bootstrap failed");
        let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").expect("bind");
        let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();

        let server = HttpServer::new(move || {
            App::new()
                .app_data(state.clone())
                .configure(backend::routes::configure)
        })
        .listen(listener)
        .expect("listen")
        .run();

        let handle = server.handle();
        let join = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            actix_web::rt::System::new()
                .block_on(server)
                .expect("server error");
        });

        let base = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", port);
        for _ in 0..50 {
            if reqwest::blocking::get(format!("{}/api/v1/health", base)).is_ok() {
                return Self {
                    base,
                    handle: Some(handle),
                    join: Some(join),
                };
            }
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));
        }
        panic!("server not ready after 5s");
    }

    pub fn url(&self, path: &str) -> String {
        format!("{}{}", self.base, path)
    }
}

impl Drop for TestServer {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(h) = self.handle.take() {
            futures::executor::block_on(h.stop(true));
        }
        if let Some(j) = self.join.take() {
            let _ = j.join();
        }
    }
}

pub struct TestUser {
    pub client: Client,
    pub token: String,
    pub id: Uuid,
    pub email: String,
}

impl Drop for TestUser {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        cleanup_user(&self.email);
    }
}

pub fn register_and_login(base: &str) -> TestUser {
    let client = Client::new();
    let uid = Uuid::new_v4();
    let username = format!("test_{}", uid);
    let email = format!("test+{}@example.com", uid);
    let password = "password123";

    let r = client
        .post(format!("{}/api/v1/auth/register", base))
        .json(&json!({
            "username": username,
            "email": email,
            "password": password,
            "native": "vi",
            "language": "en",
        }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201, "register failed: {:?}", r.text());

    let r = client
        .post(format!("{}/api/v1/auth/login", base))
        .json(&json!({ "email": email, "password": password }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200, "login failed: {:?}", r.text());
    let login: Value = r.json().unwrap();
    let token = login["token"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    let id: Uuid = login["user_id"].as_str().unwrap().parse().unwrap();

    TestUser {
        client,
        token,
        id,
        email,
    }
}

pub fn cleanup_user(email: &str) {
    use backend::infrastructure::database::schema::users;
    use diesel::prelude::*;

    let url = std::env::var("DATABASE_URL").expect("DATABASE_URL");
    let pool = backend::bootstrap::pool::init(&url);
    let mut conn = pool.get().unwrap();
    match diesel::delete(users::table.filter(users::email.eq(email))).execute(&mut conn) {
        Ok(n) => eprintln!("[cleanup] deleted {} user(s) for {}", n, email),
        Err(e) => eprintln!("[cleanup] failed: {}", e),
    }
}

    use backend::infrastructure::database::schema::users;

    let url = std::env::var("DATABASE_URL").expect("DATABASE_URL");
    let pool = backend::bootstrap::pool::init(&url);
    let mut conn = pool.get().unwrap();
    diesel::update(users::table.filter(users::email.eq(email)))
        .set(users::role.eq(role))
        .execute(&mut conn)
        .expect("set role in db failed");
}

===== FILE: backend/tests/crud/bookmark.rs =====
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::common::{TestServer, TestUser, register_and_login};

fn create_post(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer, title: &str) -> String {
    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/posts"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"title": title, "content": "body"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201);
    r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["id"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .to_string()
}

#[test]
fn add_list_check_remove() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let post_id = create_post(&user, &server, "T");

    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/bookmark", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my/bookmarks"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(list[0]["id"], post_id);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/my/bookmarks/{}", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["bookmarked"], true);

    let r = user
        .client
        .delete(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/bookmark", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/my/bookmarks/{}", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["bookmarked"], false);
}

#[test]
fn double_bookmark_conflicts() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let post_id = create_post(&user, &server, "T");

    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/bookmark", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()

===== FILE: backend/tests/crud/comment.rs =====
use rstest::*;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::common::{TestServer, TestUser, register_and_login, set_role_in_db};

fn create_post(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer, title: &str) -> String {
    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/posts"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"title": title, "content": "post body"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201, "create post: {:?}", r.text());
    r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["id"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .to_string()
}

fn create_comment(
    user: &TestUser,
    server: &TestServer,
    post_id: &str,
    content: &str,
    parent_id: Option<&str>,
) -> Value {
    let body = match parent_id {
        Some(p) => json!({"content": content, "parent_id": p}),
        None => json!({"content": content}),
    };
    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/comments", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&body)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201, "create comment: {:?}", r.text());
    r.json().unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn full_comment_crud_flow() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let post_id = create_post(&user, &server, "T");

    let created = create_comment(&user, &server, &post_id, "hello world", None);
    let comment_id = created["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    assert_eq!(created["content"], "hello world");
    assert_eq!(created["post_id"], post_id);
    assert_eq!(created["status"], "visible");
    assert_eq!(created["is_deleted"], false);
    assert_eq!(created["parent_id"], Value::Null);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/comments/{}", comment_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/comments", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(list[0]["id"], comment_id);

    let r = user
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/comments/{}", comment_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"content": "edited"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200, "update: {:?}", r.text());
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["content"], "edited");

    let r = user
        .client
        .delete(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/comments/{}", comment_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/comments/{}", comment_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 404);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/comments", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert!(list.is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn reply_to_comment_sets_parent_id() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let post_id = create_post(&user, &server, "T");

    let parent = create_comment(&user, &server, &post_id, "parent", None);
    let parent_id = parent["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();

    let child = create_comment(&user, &server, &post_id, "child", Some(&parent_id));
    assert_eq!(child["parent_id"], parent_id);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/comments", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 2);
}

#[test]
fn update_and_delete_require_ownership() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user_a = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let user_b = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let post_id = create_post(&user_a, &server, "T");
    let comment = create_comment(&user_a, &server, &post_id, "original", None);
    let comment_id = comment["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();

    let r = user_b
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/comments/{}", comment_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user_b.token)
        .json(&json!({"content": "hacked"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 403);

    let r = user_b
        .client
        .delete(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/comments/{}", comment_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user_b.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 403);

    let r = user_a
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/comments/{}", comment_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["content"], "original");
}

#[test]
fn staff_can_moderate_comment_status() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let author = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let staff = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let post_id = create_post(&author, &server, "T");
    let comment = create_comment(&author, &server, &post_id, "hello", None);
    let comment_id = comment["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();

    let r = staff
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/manage/comments/{}/status", comment_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&staff.token)
        .json(&json!({"status": "hidden"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 403);

    set_role_in_db(&staff.email, "moderator");

    let r = staff
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/manage/comments/{}/status", comment_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&staff.token)
        .json(&json!({"status": "hidden"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200, "hide: {:?}", r.text());
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["status"], "hidden");

    let r = author
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/comments", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert!(list.is_empty());

    let r = staff
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/manage/comments/{}/status", comment_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&staff.token)
        .json(&json!({"status": "visible"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
}

use serde_json::Value;

use crate::common::{TestServer, register_and_login};

#[test]
fn follow_and_list() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let alice = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let bob = register_and_login(&server.base);

    let r = alice
        .client
        .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/users/{}/follow", bob.id)))
        .bearer_auth(&alice.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);

    let r = alice
        .client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my/following"))
        .bearer_auth(&alice.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(list[0]["id"], bob.id.to_string());

    let r = bob
        .client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my/followers"))
        .bearer_auth(&bob.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(list[0]["id"], alice.id.to_string());

    let r = alice
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/users/{}/followers", bob.id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);

    let r = alice
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/my/following/{}", bob.id)))
        .bearer_auth(&alice.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["following"], true);

    let r = bob
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/my/followers/{}", alice.id)))
        .bearer_auth(&bob.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["followed_by"], true);
}

use serde_json::{Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::common::{TestServer, TestUser, register_and_login, set_status_in_db};

fn create_post(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer, title: &str) -> Uuid {
    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/posts"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"title": title, "content": "body"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201, "create post: {:?}", r.text());
    r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["id"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .parse()
        .unwrap()
}

fn follow(follower: &TestUser, followed_id: Uuid, server: &TestServer) {
    let r = follower
        .client
        .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/users/{}/follow", followed_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&follower.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);
}

fn fanout(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer, post_id: Uuid) -> reqwest::blocking::Response {
    user.client
        .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/notify-followers", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap()
}

fn fanout_count(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer, post_id: Uuid) -> i64 {
    let r = fanout(user, server, post_id);
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200, "fanout: {:?}", r.text());
    r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["notified"].as_i64().unwrap()
}

fn list_notifications(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer) -> Vec<Value> {
    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my/notifications"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    r.json().unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn fanout_notifies_all_followers() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let author = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let f1 = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let f2 = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let f3 = register_and_login(&server.base);

    follow(&f1, author.id, &server);
    follow(&f2, author.id, &server);
    follow(&f3, author.id, &server);

    let post_id = create_post(&author, &server, "Hello world");
    let notified = fanout_count(&author, &server, post_id);
    assert_eq!(notified, 3);

    for follower in [&f1, &f2, &f3] {
        let list = list_notifications(follower, &server);
        assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(list[0]["kind"], "post_created");
        assert_eq!(list[0]["link"], format!("/posts/{}", post_id));
        assert!(list[0]["message"].as_str().unwrap().contains("Hello world"));
    }
}

#[test]
fn fanout_empty_followers_returns_zero() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let author = register_and_login(&server.base);

    let post_id = create_post(&author, &server, "Lonely post");
    let notified = fanout_count(&author, &server, post_id);
    assert_eq!(notified, 0);
}

#[test]
fn fanout_does_not_notify_author() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let author = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let follower = register_and_login(&server.base);

    follow(&follower, author.id, &server);

    let post_id = create_post(&author, &server, "My post");
    let notified = fanout_count(&author, &server, post_id);
    assert_eq!(notified, 1);

    assert!(list_notifications(&author, &server).is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn fanout_message_and_link_format() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let author = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let follower = register_and_login(&server.base);

    follow(&follower, author.id, &server);

    let post_id = create_post(&author, &server, "Specific title");
    fanout_count(&author, &server, post_id);

    let list = list_notifications(&follower, &server);
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);

    let msg = list[0]["message"].as_str().unwrap();
    assert!(msg.contains(&author.id.to_string()) || msg.contains("New post from"));
    assert!(msg.contains("Specific title"));

    assert_eq!(list[0]["link"], format!("/posts/{}", post_id));
}

#[test]
fn fanout_only_author_can_trigger() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let author = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let other = register_and_login(&server.base);

    let r = fanout(&other, &server, post_id);
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 403);

    assert!(list_notifications(&follower, &server).is_empty());
}

    let follower = register_and_login(&server.base);

    fanout_count(&author, &server, post_id);

#[test]
fn different_posts_create_separate_notifications() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let author = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let follower = register_and_login(&server.base);

    follow(&follower, author.id, &server);

    let post1 = create_post(&author, &server, "First");
    let post2 = create_post(&author, &server, "Second");

    assert_eq!(fanout_count(&author, &server, post1), 1);
    assert_eq!(fanout_count(&author, &server, post2), 1);

    let list = list_notifications(&follower, &server);
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 2);

    let links: Vec<&str> = list.iter().map(|n| n["link"].as_str().unwrap()).collect();
    assert!(links.iter().any(|l| *l == format!("/posts/{}", post1)));
    assert!(links.iter().any(|l| *l == format!("/posts/{}", post2)));
}

fn fanout_does_not_dedup_against_other_kinds() {

    follow(&follower, author.id, &server);

        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/notifications"))
        .bearer_auth(&follower.token)
        .json(&json!({
            "kind": "follow",
            "target_user_id": author.id,
            "link": format!("/users/{}", follower.id),
        }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201);

    let post_id = create_post(&author, &server, "Post");
    let notified = fanout_count(&author, &server, post_id);
    assert_eq!(notified, 1);

    let list = list_notifications(&follower, &server);
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);
}

#[test]
fn fanout_notifications_are_unread() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let author = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let follower = register_and_login(&server.base);

    follow(&follower, author.id, &server);

    let post_id = create_post(&author, &server, "Post");
    fanout_count(&author, &server, post_id);

    let r = follower
        .client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my/notifications/unread-count"))
        .bearer_auth(&follower.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let count = r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["count"].as_i64().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(count, 1);
}

#[test]
fn fanout_notification_can_be_marked_read() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let author = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let follower = register_and_login(&server.base);

    follow(&follower, author.id, &server);

    let post_id = create_post(&author, &server, "Post");
    fanout_count(&author, &server, post_id);

    let list = list_notifications(&follower, &server);
    let id = list[0]["id"].as_str().unwrap();

    let r = follower
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/my/notifications/{}/read", id)))
        .bearer_auth(&follower.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["is_readed"], true);
}

use rstest::*;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::common::{TestServer, TestUser, register_and_login, set_role_in_db};

fn post_notification(
    user: &TestUser,
    server: &TestServer,
    body: Value,
) -> reqwest::blocking::Response {
    user.client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/notifications"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&body)
        .send()
        .unwrap()
}

fn create_notification(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer, body: Value) -> Value {
    let r = post_notification(user, server, body);
    assert_eq!(
        r.status(),
        201,
        "create notification failed: {:?}",
        r.text()
    );
    r.json().unwrap()
}

fn list_notifications(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer) -> Vec<Value> {
    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my/notifications"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    r.json().unwrap()
}

fn unread_count(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer) -> i64 {
    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my/notifications/unread-count"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["count"].as_i64().unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn create_follow_notification() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let alice = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let bob = register_and_login(&server.base);

    let n = create_notification(
        &alice,
        &server,
        json!({
            "kind": "follow",
            "target_user_id": bob.id,
            "link": format!("/users/{}", alice.id),
        }),
    );

    assert_eq!(n["kind"], "follow");
    assert_eq!(n["link"], format!("/users/{}", alice.id));
    assert_eq!(n["is_readed"], false);
    assert!(n["message"].as_str().unwrap().contains("started following"));

    let list = list_notifications(&bob, &server);
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(list[0]["id"], n["id"]);

    let list_alice = list_notifications(&alice, &server);
    assert!(list_alice.is_empty());
}

===== FILE: backend/tests/crud/post.rs =====
use rstest::*;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::common::{TestServer, TestUser, register_and_login, set_role_in_db};

fn tag_at(server: &TestServer, i: usize) -> String {
    let tags: Vec<Value> = reqwest::blocking::Client::new()
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/tags"))
        .send()
        .unwrap()
        .json()
        .unwrap();
    tags[i]["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()
}

fn post_with_tags(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer, title: &str, tag_ids: &[&str]) -> String {
    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/posts"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"title": title, "content": "body"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201);
    let id = r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["id"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .to_string();
    for t in tag_ids {
        let r = user
            .client
            .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/tags/{}", id, t)))
            .bearer_auth(&user.token)
            .send()
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);
    }
    id
}

#[test]
fn full_post_crud_flow() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);

    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/posts"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"title": "Hello world", "content": "This is my first post."}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201, "create: {:?}", r.text());
    let created: Value = r.json().unwrap();
    let post_id = created["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    assert_eq!(created["title"], "Hello world");
    assert_eq!(created["status"], "published");
    assert_eq!(created["author_id"], user.id.to_string());

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/users/{}/posts", user.id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(list[0]["id"], post_id);

    let r = user
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"title": "Hello again", "content": "Updated content."}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200, "update: {:?}", r.text());
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["title"], "Hello again");

    let r = user
        .client
        .delete(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 404);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/users/{}/posts", user.id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert!(list.is_empty());
}

#[rstest]
#[case::empty_title(      "".to_string(),      "content".to_string(),    400)]
#[case::whitespace_title( "   ".to_string(),   "content".to_string(),    400)]
#[case::too_long_title(   "a".repeat(256),     "content".to_string(),    400)]
#[case::too_long_content( "title".to_string(), "a".repeat(100_001),      400)]
fn create_post_validation(#[case] title: String, #[case] content: String, #[case] expected: u16) {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);

    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/posts"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({ "title": title, "content": content }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), expected, "body: {:?}", r.text());
}

#[test]
fn update_and_delete_require_ownership() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user_a = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let user_b = register_and_login(&server.base);

    let r = user_a
        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/posts"))
        .bearer_auth(&user_a.token)
        .json(&json!({"title": "T", "content": "C"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201);
    let post_id = r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["id"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .to_string();

    let r = user_b
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user_b.token)
        .json(&json!({"title": "Hacked", "content": "Content"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 403);

    let r = user_b
        .client
        .delete(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user_b.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 403);

    let r = user_a
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
}

#[test]
fn staff_can_hide_and_restore_post() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);

    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/posts"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"title": "T", "content": "C"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let post_id = r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["id"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .to_string();

    let r = user
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/manage/posts/{}/status", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"status": "hidden"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 403);

    set_role_in_db(&user.email, "admin");

    let r = user
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/manage/posts/{}/status", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"status": "hidden"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200, "hide: {:?}", r.text());
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["status"], "hidden");

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 404);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/users/{}/posts", user.id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert!(list.is_empty());

    let r = user
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/manage/posts/{}/status", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"status": "published"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
}

#[test]
fn lock_comments_blocks_new_comments() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);

    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/posts"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"title": "T", "content": "C"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let post_id = r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["id"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .to_string();

    let r = user
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/comments/lock", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"locked": true}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    assert_eq!(r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["comments_locked"], true);

    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/comments", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"content": "Hello"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 403);

    let r = user
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/comments/lock", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"locked": false}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);

    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/comments", post_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"content": "Hello"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201);
}

#[test]
fn search_excludes_hidden_and_deleted() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let live = post_with_tags(&user, &server, "keepme", &[]);
    let hidden = post_with_tags(&user, &server, "keepme", &[]);
    let deleted = post_with_tags(&user, &server, "keepme", &[]);

    set_role_in_db(&user.email, "admin");
    let r = user
        .client
        .patch(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/manage/posts/{}/status", hidden)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({"status": "hidden"}))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);

    let r = user
        .client
        .delete(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}", deleted)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);

    let list: Vec<Value> = user
        .client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/posts?q=keepme"))
        .send()
        .unwrap()
        .json()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(list.iter().any(|p| p["id"] == live));
    assert!(!list.iter().any(|p| p["id"] == hidden));
    assert!(!list.iter().any(|p| p["id"] == deleted));
}

    let alice = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let bob = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let post_id = create_post(&alice, &server);

    for (user, emoji) in [(&alice, "❤️"), (&bob, "👍")] {
        let r = user
            .client
            .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/reactions", post_id)))
            .bearer_auth(&user.token)
            .json(&json!({"emoji": emoji}))
            .send()
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    }

    let r = alice
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/reactions", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    let list: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 2);
}


===== FILE: backend/tests/crud/README.md =====
# CRUD Tests

## Files

| File | Domain | Nội dung chính |
|---|---|---|
| `user.rs` | Auth + profile | Register, login, logout, `/my`, đổi mật khẩu |
| `post.rs` | Post | CRUD, ownership, staff moderation, comment lock |
| `comment.rs` | Comment | CRUD, reply tree, ownership, staff moderation, restore |
| `bookmark.rs` | Bookmark | Add/remove, conflict, post đã xoá bị ẩn |
| `follow.rs` | Follow | Follow/unfollow, self-follow, conflict |
| `reaction.rs` | Reaction | Upsert, đổi emoji, remove, summary, list |
| `tag.rs` | Tag | Attach/detach, ownership, conflict, list posts theo tag |
| `translation.rs` | Translation | Auth guard, missing post, missing provider |

## Nội dung test

Mỗi file phủ các nhánh:

- Happy path: full CRUD flow
- Validation: input không hợp lệ → 4xx
- Auth: 401 khi thiếu token
- Ownership: 403 khi không phải owner
- Moderation: 403 hoặc 200 tùy role
- Edge case: missing resource, deleted resource, hành động lặp

Không test serialization shape, không test wording của error message, không test OpenAPI.

## Parametrize

Validation dùng `#[rstest]`:

```rust
#[rstest]
#[case::empty(      "".to_string(),      400)]
#[case::whitespace( "   ".to_string(),   400)]
#[case::too_long(   "a".repeat(10_001),  400)]
fn create_comment_validation(#[case] content: String, #[case] expected: u16) { ... }
```

Tên case (`::empty`, `::whitespace`) xuất hiện trong output `cargo test`. Khi fail, biết ngay case nào.

Khi viết case mới, kiểm tra param có thực sự được truyền vào request body. Case `bad_language` từng fail vì test hardcode `"language": "en"` thay vì dùng param.

## Helper trong file

Mỗi file có helper riêng để giảm boilerplate:

```rust
fn create_post(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer, title: &str) -> String { ... }
fn create_comment(user: &TestUser, server: &TestServer, post_id: &str, content: &str, parent_id: Option<&str>) -> Value { ... }
```

Helper đặt private trong file, không export. Trả `String` (id) thay vì `Value` để test dễ đọc.

## Chi tiết từng file

### `user.rs`

- Full flow: register → login → `/my` → logout → token cũ bị từ chối (401)
- Register validation: password ngắn, language sai, username ngắn
- Login reject: sai password, email không tồn tại
- Lấy user public
- Cập nhật profile (bio, institute)
- Đổi mật khẩu: token cũ invalidated, password mới đăng nhập được

### `post.rs`

- Full CRUD: create → get → list theo author → update → delete → 404
- Validation: title rỗng, toàn whitespace, title > 255, content > 100k
- Auth: 401 khi không có token
- Ownership: user B không update/delete post của A → 403
- Staff: hide/restore, post ẩn không xuất hiện trong list public
- Comment lock: khoá thì comment mới bị từ chối (403), mở khoá thì comment được

### `comment.rs`

- Full CRUD, sau delete thì GET trả 404
- Reply: `parent_id` được set đúng, reply chéo post bị từ chối (404)
- Validation: rỗng, whitespace, > 10k ký tự
- Auth và ownership
- Staff: đổi status visible/hidden, restore comment đã xoá
- `/my/comments` list, comment đã xoá bị ẩn

### `bookmark.rs`

- Add → list → kiểm tra status → remove
- Bookmark trùng → 409
- Remove bookmark không tồn tại → 404
- Bookmark post không tồn tại → 404
- Auth guard
- Post đã xoá bị ẩn khỏi `/my/bookmarks`

### `follow.rs`

- Follow → list followers/following → kiểm tra status (`is_following`, `is_followed_by`)
- Unfollow xoá relationship
- Self-follow → 400
- Follow trùng → 409
- User không tồn tại → 404
- Auth guard

### `reaction.rs`

- Upsert → summary group theo emoji
- Đổi emoji: upsert ghi đè
- Remove → GET lại trả 404
- Emoji validation: rỗng, whitespace, > 32 ký tự
- Post không tồn tại → 404
- Auth guard
- List toàn bộ reaction trên 1 post

### `tag.rs`

- List toàn bộ tag (seed 5 tag)
- Get theo id
- Attach → get post tags → get tag posts → detach
- Attach trùng → 409
- Detach tag chưa attach → 409
- Ownership: chỉ author của post attach/detach được
- Tag không tồn tại → 404

### `translation.rs`

- Auth guard
- Post không tồn tại → 404
- Không cấu hình provider → 503 (skip nếu `TRANSLATION_API_KEY` được set)

Không test translation thật vì: cần API key trả phí, response phụ thuộc LLM (không deterministic). Cache đã được test gián tiếp qua flow edit post (tạo translation → edit → cache bị invalidate).

#[test]
fn attach_and_detach_tag() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);
    let post_id = create_post(&user, &server);
    let tag_id = first_tag_id(&server);

    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/tags/{}", post_id, tag_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204, "attach: {:?}", r.text());

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/tags", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let tags: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tags.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(tags[0]["id"], tag_id);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/tags/{}/posts", tag_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let posts: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(posts.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(posts[0]["id"], post_id);

    let r = user
        .client
        .delete(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/tags/{}", post_id, tag_id)))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url(&format!("/api/v1/posts/{}/tags", post_id)))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    let tags: Vec<Value> = r.json().unwrap();
    assert!(tags.is_empty());
}

===== FILE: backend/tests/crud/user.rs =====
use rstest::*;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::common::{TestServer, register_and_login};

#[test]
fn full_auth_flow() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let client = reqwest::blocking::Client::new();
    let uid = Uuid::new_v4();
    let username = format!("test_{}", uid);
    let email = format!("test+{}@example.com", uid);
    let password = "password123";

    let r = client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/auth/register"))
        .json(&json!({
            "username": username,
            "email": email,
            "password": password,
            "native": "vi",
            "language": "en",
        }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201, "register: {:?}", r.text());

    let r = client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/auth/login"))
        .json(&json!({ "email": email, "password": password }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    let login: Value = r.json().unwrap();
    let token = login["token"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();

    let r = client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my"))
        .bearer_auth(&token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    let me: Value = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(me["email"], email);
    assert_eq!(me["username"], username);
    assert_eq!(me["role"], "user");
    assert_eq!(me["native"], "vi");
    assert_eq!(me["language"], "vi");

    let r = client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/auth/logout"))
        .bearer_auth(&token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);

    let r = client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my"))
        .bearer_auth(&token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 401);

    crate::common::cleanup_user(&email);
}

#[test]
fn register_language_defaults_to_native() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let client = reqwest::blocking::Client::new();
    let uid = Uuid::new_v4();
    let username = format!("test_{}", uid);
    let email = format!("test+{}@example.com", uid);
    let password = "password123";

    let r = client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/auth/register"))
        .json(&json!({
            "username": username,
            "email": email,
            "password": password,
            "native": "ja",
            "language": "en",
        }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 201, "register: {:?}", r.text());

    let r = client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/auth/login"))
        .json(&json!({ "email": email, "password": password }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    let token = r.json::<Value>().unwrap()["token"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .to_string();

    let r = client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my"))
        .bearer_auth(&token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
    let me: Value = r.json().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(me["native"], "ja");
    assert_eq!(me["language"], "ja");

    crate::common::cleanup_user(&email);
}

#[rstest]
#[case::weak_password("test_user", "x.com", "short", "vi", 400)]
#[case::bad_native("test_user", "x.com", "password123", "xx", 400)]
#[case::short_username("ab", "x.com", "password123", "vi", 400)]
fn register_rejects_invalid_input(
    #[case] username: &str,
    #[case] domain: &str,
    #[case] password: &str,
    #[case] native: &str,
    #[case] expected: u16,
) {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let client = reqwest::blocking::Client::new();
    let uid = Uuid::new_v4();
    let email = format!("test+{}@{}", uid, domain);

    let r = client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/auth/register"))
        .json(&json!({
            "username": username,
            "email": email,
            "password": password,
            "native": native,
            "language": native,
        }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), expected, "body: {:?}", r.text());
    crate::common::cleanup_user(&email);
}

#[rstest]
#[case::wrong_password("wrong_pass", 401)]
#[case::no_such_user("whatever", 401)]
fn login_rejects_invalid_credentials(#[case] password: &str, #[case] expected: u16) {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let client = reqwest::blocking::Client::new();
    let uid = Uuid::new_v4();
    let email = format!("test+{}@example.com", uid);

    let r = client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/auth/login"))
        .json(&json!({ "email": email, "password": password }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), expected);
}

#[test]
fn change_password_invalidates_token() {
    let server = TestServer::start();
    let user = register_and_login(&server.base);

    let r = user
        .client
        .patch(server.url("/api/v1/my/password"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .json(&json!({
            "current_password": "password123",
            "new_password": "newpassword456",
        }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 204);

    let r = user
        .client
        .get(server.url("/api/v1/my"))
        .bearer_auth(&user.token)
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 401, "old token should be invalidated");

    let r = user
        .client
        .post(server.url("/api/v1/auth/login"))
        .json(&json!({ "email": user.email, "password": "newpassword456" }))
        .send()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), 200);
}
